item.title: National Assembly Passes 'Election Commission Special Counsel Act'… Bipartisan Agreement (‘선관위 특검법’ 국회 본회의 의결…여야 합의)
item.description:
The National Assembly convened a plenary session on the 30th and passed a bill on the appointment of a special counsel to investigate allegations of infringement of citizens' right to participate, including the shortage of ballots for the 9th nationwide simultaneous local elections, which was prepared through bipartisan agreement (Election Commission Special Counsel Act). (국회는 30일 본회의를 열어 여야 합의로 마련된 제9회 전국동시지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태 등 국민참정권 침해 의혹 진상규명을 위한 특별검사의 임명 등에 관한 법률안(선관위 특검법)을 의결했다.)

The scope and targets of the special counsel investigation include: △alleged incidents where citizens' exercise of their right to participate was infringed; △alleged incidents where vote counting was forced without suspension or preservation measures after allegations of poor ballot management emerged; △alleged cases of procedural violations and abuse of authority, such as the reduction of the lower limit for the quantity of official ballots printed by the National Election Commission; △and alleged incidents of manipulation of voter turnout statistics, errors in the election management system's electronic data entry, and election statistics manipulation. (특검 수사 대상과 범위는 △국민의 참정권 행사가 침해됐다는 의혹 사건 △투표과정 부실 관리 의혹 발생 이후 개표 중단·보전 조치 없이 개표를 강행한 의혹 사건 △선거관리위원회의 본투표용지 인쇄 물량 하한 기준 축소 등 절차적 위법 및 직권남용 등 혐의 사건 △투표율 집계 조작 등 선거관리 시스템 전산 입력 오류 및 선거 통계 조작 의혹 사건 등이다.)

The special counsel investigation also covers the overall operations of the Election Commission, including overseas junkets by former and current commissioners and related personnel, unfair or preferential hiring, non-competitive contracts, and collusion with vendors. (선관위 전·현직 위원 및 관계자의 외유성 출장, 부정·특혜 채용, 수의계약·업체 유착 등 기관 운영 전반도 특검 수사 대상이다.)

Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr (이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr)

item.title: [Breaking] Bill to fully abolish prosecutors' supplementary investigative powers submitted to National Assembly plenary session ([속보] ‘검사 보완수사권 전면 폐지’ 형사소송법안 국회 본회의 상정)
item.description:
The National Assembly submitted a revised Criminal Procedure Act to its plenary session on the 30th, which includes the full abolition of prosecutors' supplementary investigative powers. As the People Power Party, opposing the bill, has launched a filibuster (unlimited debate), the vote is expected to take place on the 31st. (국회는 30일 본회의에 ‘검사 보완수사권 전면 폐지’를 담은 형사소송법 개정안을 상정했다. 이 법안에 반대하는 국민의힘이 필리버스터(무제한 토론)에 나서 표결은 31일 이뤄질 전망이다.)

Lee Ji-eun, Reporter jieuny@hani.co.kr (이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr)

item.title: ‘Special Counsel Act on Election Commission’ Passes National Assembly… 2.47 Million Ballot Papers in Jamsil to be Recounted (‘선관위 특검법’ 국회 통과…잠실 투표지 247만장 재검표 한다)
item.description:
On the 30th, the National Assembly passed the special counsel act for the Election Commission, aimed at uncovering the truth behind the ballot paper shortage during the June 3 local elections, with agreement from both ruling and opposition parties. On the same day, the two parties extended the activities of the National Assembly’s Special Committee on the Election Commission’s parliamentary investigation by 30 days. (6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족사태 진상 규명을 위한 선거관리위원회 특별검사법이 30일 여야 합의로 국회 본회의를 통과했다. 여야는 이날 선관위 국정조사특별위원회(국조특위) 활동기간을 30일간 연장했다.)

The National Assembly held a plenary session that afternoon and passed the “Act on the Appointment of a Special Counsel for Investigating Allegations of Infringement on Citizens’ Right to Participate, Including the Ballot Paper Shortage in the 9th Nationwide Concurrent Local Elections” with 226 votes in favor and 2 against out of 228 attending lawmakers. (국회는 이날 오후 본회의를 열고 재석 의원 228명 가운데 찬성 226표, 반대 2표로 ‘제9회 전국동시지방선거 투표용지 부족사태 등 국민참정권 침해 의혹 진상규명을 위한 특별검사 임명 등에 관한 법률안’(선관위 특검법)을 가결했다.)

According to the special counsel act, the investigative team will consist of up to 5 special counsel assistants, 70 special investigators, up to 20 dispatched prosecutors, and up to 70 dispatched public officials excluding the prosecutors. The special counsel can prepare for the task within 20 days of appointment and must complete the investigation within 90 days from the day after the preparation period ends, determining whether to press charges. If necessary, the investigation period can be extended twice by 30 days each, allowing activities for up to 150 days. Including the preparation period, the investigation can last up to 170 days. (특검법을 보면 수사 인력은 특검보 5명, 특별수사관 70명, 파견검사 20명 이내, 파견검사를 제외한 파견공무원 70명 이내로 했다. 특검은 임명된 날로부터 20일 이내에 직무수행에 필요한 준비를 할 수 있고, 준비기간 만료 다음 날부터 90일 이내에 수사를 완료하고 공소제기 여부를 결정해야 한다. 필요한 경우 2회에 걸쳐 각 30일씩 수사 기간을 연장해 최장 150일 활동할 수 있다. 준비기간을 포함하면 최장 170일 수사가 가능하다. )

The scope of the investigation, which was a key issue, includes: allegations that citizens’ right to participate was violated due to the shortage of ballot papers; allegations of computational errors in the election management system, such as manipulation of voter turnout tallies and election statistics; and cases identified during the investigation of the target incidents. (핵심 쟁점이었던 수사 대상에는 △투표용지 부족으로 국민 참정권 행사가 침해된 의혹 △투표율 집계 조작 등 선거관리 시스템 전산 입력 오류·선거 통계 조작 의혹 △수사 대상 사건 관련 수사 과정에서 인지된 사건 등이 포함됐다.)

The ruling and opposition parties had been at odds over the scope and targets of the investigation until the previous day, but before the plenary session, Han Byeong-do of the Democratic Party and Jeong Jeom-sik of the People Power Party, both floor leaders, reached an agreement on the special counsel act for the Election Commission that morning. (여야는 수사 대상과 범위를 두고 전날까지 평행선을 달렸지만, 본회의에 앞서 한병도 더불어민주당·정점식 국민의힘 원내대표는 이날 오전 선관위 특검법 처리에 합의했다.)

Previously, on the 21st, the parties had agreed to recommend the special counsel through a national recommendation committee. The committee will receive three candidates each from both parties, recommended by the Korean Bar Association and the Council of Law School Deans, and then recommend two candidates to the president by consensus. The president will appoint one of them as the special counsel. (앞서 여야는 지난 21일 특검 추천 방식에 대해선 국민추천위원회를 통해 특검을 추천하기로 합의한 바 있다. 국민추천위는 대한변호사협회와 법학전문대학원협의회로부터 여야가 각각 특검 후보 3명씩을 추천받은 뒤 이 중 2명을 여야 합의로 대통령에게 추천하며, 대통령은 그중 1명을 특검으로 임명하도록 했다.)

Meanwhile, the plenary session also passed a motion to extend the activities of the National Assembly’s Special Committee on the Election Commission’s parliamentary investigation, which was set to end on the 1st of next month, by 30 days until the 30th of next month. The special committee plans to hold a third hearing on the 10th of next month and proceed with an on-site verification of the recount of 2.47 million ballot papers stored at the ballot counting station in Songpa District on the 18th. (한편 이날 본회의에서 다음달 1일로 활동 기한이 종료되는 선관위 국조특위 활동 기간을 다음달 30일까지 30일 연장하는 안건도 의결했다. 국조특위는 다음달 10일 제3차 청문회를 열고, 18일 247만장의 투표지가 보관된 송파구 개표소 재검표 현장 검증을 추진하기로 했다.)

Reporter Kim Hae-jeong sea@hani.co.kr (김해정 기자 sea@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Ruling Party's Internal Strife Continues… Supreme Council 'Cracks' Over Additional Appointment of 2 Ethics Committee Members (국힘 내홍 계속…윤리위원 2명 추가 임명에 최고위 내 ‘파열음’)
item.description:
The People Power Party's Supreme Council filled two vacant seats on the Central Ethics Committee on the 30th, leading to expectations that discussions on disciplinary actions against lawmakers Cho Kyung-tae, Kwon Young-jin, and Jin Jong-oh will accelerate. However, internal opposition within the Supreme Council over the appointment of ethics committee members suggests the party's internal strife is ongoing. (국민의힘 최고위원회가 30일 공석이던 중앙윤리위원 2자리를 채우면서 조경태·권영진·진종오 의원에 대한 징계 논의에 속도가 붙을 거란 전망이 나온다. 윤리위원 임명을 두고 최고위 내부에서 반발이 나오는 등 당 내홍은 계속되는 모양새다.)

Chief Spokesperson Choi Bo-yoon told reporters after the party's Supreme Council meeting that day, "In the past, two ethics committee members resigned after their names were disclosed by the media, causing them pressure and burden. Considering this, we decided to appoint two additional members," adding, "It was to ensure the ethics committee operates smoothly." The two newly appointed members are known to be legal professionals, not party members. The ethics committee, which has a maximum capacity of nine members, had been operating with five members due to a series of resignations. Controversy over procedural legitimacy arose when a meeting attended by just three members voted to initiate disciplinary proceedings against sitting lawmakers. (최보윤 수석대변인은 이날 당 최고위원회의가 끝난 뒤 기자들을 만나 “과거 윤리위원 2명이 실명이 언론에 공개돼 압박과 부담을 느껴 사임했는데, 이를 고려해 추가 2명을 임명하게 됐다”며 “(윤리위가) 원활하게 진행하도록 선임한 것”이라고 했다. 이번에 임명된 위원 2명은 당원이 아닌 법조인으로 알려졌다. 정원이 최대 9명인 윤리위는 최근 위원들의 잇단 사퇴로 5명 체제로 운영돼왔다. 이 가운데 3명만 참석한 회의에서 현역 의원에 대한 징계 개시를 의결하면서 절차적 정당성 논란이 불거졌다.)

Cracks also emerged during the process of appointing additional ethics committee members that day. Supreme Council member Woo Jae-joon objected, saying, "We are in a situation where we should investigate whether the ethics committee is being run in a biased manner, but I cannot agree with the stance of pushing ahead with the ethics committee by merely filling the vacancies left by those who resigned." However, the Supreme Council proceeded to a vote, with only Woo and Supreme Council member Yang Hyang-ja expressing opposition and abstention, respectively, and the appointment agenda passed with six votes in favor. Raised voices were also exchanged as Woo left his seat in protest. (이날 윤리위원 추가 임명 과정에서도 파열음이 이어졌다. 우재준 최고위원이 “윤리위가 편향적으로 운영되고 있는 게 아닌지 조사해야 하는 상황인데, 사퇴한 사람들 자리 공백만 메워서 윤리위를 강행하겠다는 기조에 동의할 수 없다”고 반발했다. 그러나 최고위는 표결에 들어갔고 우 최고위원과 양향자 최고위원만 각각 반대와 기권 의사를 밝히며 찬성 6명으로 임명 안건이 가결됐다. 우 최고위원이 반발하며 자리를 뜨는 과정에서 고성도 오갔다.)

Ethics Committee Chairman Yoon Min-woo issued a statement that day, warning, "If violations of the duty to maintain confidentiality regarding internal discussions within the ethics committee recur, I will take strict measures, such as requesting the party leader to dismiss the ethics committee member in question, in accordance with relevant regulations." This appeared to target Vice Chairman Woo Jong-hwan and Ethics Committee member Hwang Kyung-sung, who had previously issued a public statement opposing Chairman Yoon's unilateral management and boycotted the meeting. It was also reported that opinions were raised during the closed-door Supreme Council meeting that Vice Chairman Woo should be dismissed. (윤민우 윤리위원장은 이날 입장문을 내어 “윤리위 내부 논의와 관련된 비밀유지 의무 위반이 재발할 경우, 관련 규정에 따라 해당 윤리위원의 해임을 당대표에게 요청하는 등 엄정하게 조치할 것”이라고 경고했다. 앞서 윤 위원장의 독단적 운영에 반발하는 공개 입장을 내고 회의에 불참한 우종환 부위원장과 황경성 윤리위원을 겨냥한 발언으로 보인다. 이날 비공개 최고위에서도 우 부위원장을 해임해야 한다는 의견이 나온 것으로 전해졌다.)

Meanwhile, lawmaker Kwon, who initiated disciplinary proceedings after grabbing the collar of floor leader Chung Jin-suk in protest of committee assignments, apologized during a closed-door general meeting of lawmakers, saying, "I will earnestly engage in the ethics committee's disciplinary process and calmly await the results. I hope the issue of my discipline does not become a source of conflict or division among lawmakers." (한편 상임위원회 배분에 항의하며 정점식 원내대표의 멱살을 잡아 징계 절차가 개시된 권 의원은 비공개 의원총회에서 “윤리위 징계절차에 성실히 임하고 결과를 차분히 기다리겠다. 저의 징계 문제가 의원들간 갈등과 분열의 요소가 되지 않기를 바란다”고 사과했다.)

Reporter Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr Reporter Jo Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr (장나래 기자 wing@hani.co.kr 조희연 기자 choh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: JCS: 'Unidentified Aircraft in Northern Gyeonggi Civilian Control Zone Was US Military Drone on Training' (합참 “경기 북부 민통선 미확인 비행체는 훈련중인 미군 무인기”)
item.description:
The Joint Chiefs of Staff (JCS) announced on the afternoon of the 30th that an unidentified aircraft spotted south of the General Outpost (GOP) line in northern Gyeonggi Province was confirmed to be a US military drone. (합동참모본부(합참)는 30일 오후 경기 북부 지오피(GOP·일반전초) 이남지역에서 미확인 비행체를 식별해 확인한 결과 미군 소속 무인기로 판명됐다고 밝혔다.)

The JCS explained that soldiers in the area detected the unidentified aircraft using thermal observation device (TOD) equipment, initiated a response according to operational procedures, and concluded the situation after confirming it was a US military drone undergoing training. A JCS official said regarding the military's response, "No firing or shoot-down procedures were initiated," adding, "The drone was identified south of the GOP line." The US military drone was spotted in the vicinity of the Civilian Control Line (CCL), south of the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ). ( 합참은 해당 지역 부대 장병이 열상감시(TOD) 장비로 미확인 비행체를 포착해 작전수행절차에 따라 대응에 들어갔고, 훈련 중인 미군 무인기로 확인한 뒤 상황을 종료했다고 설명했다. 합참 관계자는 군의 대응과 관련해 “발포 등 격추 절차에 들어가지 않았다”며 “해당 무인기는 지오피 이남 지역에서 식별됐다”고 말했다. 미군 무인기가 비무장지대 남쪽인 민간인통제선(민통선) 일대에서 식별됐다는 것이다. )

The DMZ is established with a total width of 4 km, extending 2 km each north and south from the Military Demarcation Line (MDL). The Southern Limit Line is located 2 km south of the MDL, with GOPs situated along it. The CCL lies south of the Southern Limit Line. ( 비무장지대는 군사분계선(휴전선)을 기준으로 남북 방향으로 각각 2㎞씩, 총 너비 4㎞에 설정돼 있다. 군사분계선에서 남쪽으로 2㎞ 떨어진 곳에 남방한계선이 있고 이를 따라 지오피들이 있다. 남방한계선 이남에 민통선이 있다.)

When asked whether the area where the US military drone was identified falls under the United Nations Command's 'No-Fly Zone' near the MDL or a zone where drone operations are restricted under the September 19 inter-Korean military agreement, the official responded, "I will check." <<> In response to inquiries about whether US Forces Korea (USFK) was conducting training in northern Gyeonggi on that day, the JCS explained, "We only confirmed on-site that it was a US military drone; we need to verify the specific flight path." The military authorities plan to check whether the US provided prior notification to South Korean forces regarding the US military drone training near the CCL, or if such notification was given but not shared internally within South Korea's military. ( 이 관계자는 미군 무인기가 식별된 지역이 유엔군사령부가 군사분계선 근처에 설정한 비행금지구역인 ‘노 플라이존'에 해당하는지, 2018년 9·19 남북 군사합의에 따라 무인기 운용이 제한되는 구역인지에 대해서는 “확인하겠다”고 밝혔다. )

Since North Korean drones violated the airspace over the Seoul metropolitan area in December 2022, South Korean military authorities have frequently conducted drone response drills in the border areas of northern Gyeonggi and Gangwon. On that day, village heads near the CCL received text messages stating, 'A drone has been identified in the Cheorwon area; urgently move to nearby shelters or outside control points.' The JCS said regarding the circumstances of sending civilian evacuation texts, "We will review the matter comprehensively and provide further explanation." ( 합참은 이날 경기 북부지역에서 주한미군이 훈련 중인지 묻자 “현장에서 미군 무인기인 것만 확인했고 구체적인 항적은 확인해 봐야 한다”고 설명했다. 군 당국은 미국이 민통선 근처에서 훈련하는 미군 무인기 관련 정보를 사전에 한국군에 알리지 않았는지, 통보가 됐는데 한국군 내부에서 공유되지 않았는지를 확인할 예정이다. )

By Kwon Hyuk-chul, Reporter: nura@hani.co.kr ( 2022년 12월 북한 무인기의 수도권 영공 침범 이후 군 당국은 경기 북부·강원 접경 지역에서 무인기 대응 훈련을 자주 해왔다. 이날 민통선 근처 마을 이장들에게 ‘철원 지역에 무인기가 식별돼 긴급히 인근 대피호 또는 통제소 밖으로 이동해야 한다'는 내용의 문자가 발송됐다. 합참은 주민 대피 문자 발송 경위 등에 대해 “전반적으로 다시 확인한 뒤 추가로 설명하겠다”고 밝혔다. )

item.title: "US-Saudi Nuclear Agreement Could Be an Opportunity for Korea to Introduce Enrichment" (“미-사우디 원자력 협정, 한국 농축 도입에 기회 요인 될 것”)
item.description:
An analysis suggests that the nuclear cooperation agreement between the United States and Saudi Arabia could serve as an opportunity to facilitate discussions on introducing uranium enrichment for South Korea in the ongoing nuclear negotiations between South Korea and the U.S. (미국과 사우디아라비아가 맺은 원자력 협력 협정이 한·미가 논의 중인 원자력 협상에서 한국의 농축 도입 논의를 촉진하는 데 기회 요인이 될 수 있다는 분석이 나왔다.)

In a report titled "Trump's Permission for Saudi Enrichment and Its Impact and Implications on South Korea's Introduction of Enrichment," released on the 29th by the Sejong Institute, Visiting Research Fellow Jeon Bong-geun stated, "(The Saudi agreement) confirms that U.S. cooperation on enrichment is not an absolute taboo," adding, "The logic that the U.S. tries to confine South Korea's enrichment demands to the realm of taboo is inevitably weakened." ( 세종연구소가 지난 29일 낸 전봉근 세종연구소 객원연구위원의 ‘트럼프의 사우디 농축 허용이 한국의 농축 도입에 미칠 영향과 시사점’ 보고서는 “(사우디 협정은) 미국의 농축 협력이 절대적인 금기가 아니라는 점을 확인했다는 데 있다”며 “미국이 한국의 농축 요구를 금기의 영역에 묶어두려는 논리는 약화될 수밖에 없다”고 했다. )

The nuclear cooperation agreement signed between the U.S. and Saudi Arabia on the 22nd (local time) in Washington, D.C., is evaluated to have paved the way for Saudi Arabia to conduct uranium enrichment, albeit with the precondition that feasibility must be proven through a two-year joint study by both countries. Instead of signing a separate safeguards agreement with the U.S., Saudi Arabia was exempted from the Additional Protocol for inspections by the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA). Research Fellow Jeon noted, "South Korea has incomparably better performance and capabilities than Saudi Arabia in nuclear power plant operation and export, nuclear fuel manufacturing, safety regulation and export control, and implementation of IAEA safeguards," and added, "It could use the Saudi agreement case as a negotiation asset to promote discussions on introducing enrichment." ( 앞서 미국과 사우디가 지난 22일(현지시각) 미국 워싱턴에서 맺은 원자력 협력 협정은 ‘양국의 2년 공동 연구로 타당성을 입증해야 한다’는 전제가 있으나, 사우디에 우라늄 농축을 할 수 있는 길을 터줬다는 평가를 받는다. 사우디는 미국과 별도 안전조치협정을 맺는 대신 국제원자력기구(IAEA) 사찰을 위한 추가의정서를 면제받았다. 전 연구위원은 “한국은 원전 운영과 수출, 핵연료 제조, 안전규제와 수출통제, 국제원자력기구 안전조치 이행에서 사우디와 비교할 수 없을 정도로 양호한 실적과 역량을 갖고 있다”며 “사우디 협정 사례를 협상 자산으로 활용해 농축 도입 논의를 촉진시킬 수 있을 것”이라고 했다. )

The Saudi case also presents challenges. The report pointed out that if this agreement sparks backlash from the U.S. Congress and the non-proliferation camp, the U.S. might impose stricter conditions on South Korea's enrichment demands to prevent the spread of similar cases. ( 사우디 사례가 주는 도전 요인도 있다. 보고서는 이번 협정이 미국 의회와 비확산 진영의 반발을 부를 경우, 미국이 후속 사례의 확산을 막기 위해 한국의 농축 요구에 더 엄격한 조건을 제기할 가능성도 있다고 짚었다. )

Saudi Arabia's negotiation strategy in the context of U.S.-China competition also warrants attention. It is said that Saudi Arabia actively used the possibility of nuclear cooperation with Russia or China as a bargaining chip to secure exceptional treatment from the U.S. on enrichment and nuclear non-proliferation issues. This highlighted the risk that the U.S. could not only lose a massive nuclear power plant market but also lose information and control over Saudi Arabia's nuclear development program. ( 미중 경쟁 구도 속 사우디의 협상 전략도 유의해 볼 필요가 있다. 사우디는 미국으로부터 농축과 핵비확산 문제의 예외적 대우를 받기 위해 러시아 또는 중국과의 원자력 협력 가능성을 협상 지렛대로 적극 활용했다고 한다. 미국이 거대한 원전 시장을 잃을 뿐 아니라, 사우디 핵개발 프로그램에 대한 정보와 통제력도 잃을 수 있다는 점을 부각했다는 것이다. )

However, Research Fellow Jeon suggested, "South Korea is an ally of the U.S., a model country in the international non-proliferation regime, and a nation operating within the institutional framework of South Korea-U.S. nuclear cooperation. Rather than directly imitating Saudi-style diplomacy and negotiation tactics, enrichment negotiations should be pursued by accumulating common interests—such as stable nuclear fuel supply chains, benefits for the U.S. nuclear industry, joint technological development, and access to international markets—while maintaining a stable South Korea-U.S. alliance and non-proliferation credibility." ( 다만 전 연구위원은 “한국은 미국의 동맹국이자 국제 비확산 체제의 모범국이며, 한미 원자력 협력의 제도적 틀 안에서 움직이는 국가”라며 “사우디식 외교술과 협상술을 그대로 모방하기보다, 안정적인 한미동맹과 비확산 신뢰성을 유지하면서 핵연료 공급망의 안정, 미국 원자력 산업의 이익, 양국의 공동 기술개발과 국제시장 진출이라는 공동 이익을 축적하는 방식으로 농축 협상을 추진해야 한다”고 제안했다. )

In the long term, Research Fellow Jeon proposed that the government should manage the enrichment issue as a national agenda. He stated, "The Presidential Office and the National Security Office should take the lead, while the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and ministries related to nuclear energy, industry, and science and technology should jointly develop policies and negotiation strategies." To this end, he emphasized the need to prepare a basic law outlining the principle of peaceful use of nuclear energy and government responsibilities, as well as a non-proliferation basic law that excludes nuclear weapons development and strengthens international non-proliferation obligations and domestic implementation systems. ( 장기적으론 정부가 농축 문제를 국가 의제로 관리해야 한다는 게 전 연구위원의 제안이다. 그는 “대통령실과 국가안보실이 중심을 잡고 외교부와 원자력·에너지·산업·과학기술 관련 부처가 공동의 정책과 협상전략을 마련해야 한다“고 말했다. 이를 위해 원자력의 평화적 이용 원칙과 정부 책임을 규정하기 위한 기본법과, 핵무기 개발을 배제하고 국제 비확산 의무와 국내 이행체계를 강화하는 비확산 기본법 등을 준비할 필요가 있다. )

Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr ( 장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: U.S. Ambassador Steel: "Born in Seoul, Standing Here Today… The Ironclad U.S.-ROK Alliance" (스틸 미국대사 “서울서 태어나 이 자리에…한미 철통같은 동맹”)
item.description:
New U.S. Ambassador to South Korea, Michelle Steel, stated on the 30th, "I look forward to working with Korea to ensure our ironclad alliance remains the linchpin of peace and security in the region." (미셸 스틸 신임 주한미국대사가 30일 “우리(한미)의 철통같은 동맹이 역내 평화와 안보를 지탱하는 핵심축으로 남아있도록 한국과 노력해 나가길 기대한다”고 밝혔다.)

Ambassador Steel arrived at Incheon International Airport that afternoon and met with reporters in the briefing area. She greeted them in Korean, saying, "I was born in Seoul, but I stand here representing the United States. Standing here again brings a mix of emotions." She then continued in English. (스틸 대사는 이날 오후 인천국제공항을 통해 입국한 뒤 브리핑장에서 취재진과 만나 한국말로 “저는 서울에서 태어났지만 미국을 대표해 이 자리에 섰습니다. 이 자리에 다시 서니 만감이 교차합니다”라고 인사한 뒤 영어로 이렇게 말했다.)

She added, "In Gyeongju, President Donald Trump and President Lee Jae-myung opened a new chapter for our alliance. We will work together to realize President Trump’s vision for the alliance, which will be stronger, safer, and more prosperous than ever." Ambassador Steel further emphasized the importance of the alliance, stating, "Our alliance was forged in war and secured by the blood of those who stood shoulder to shoulder to defend freedom. Today, the U.S.-ROK alliance is one of the strongest in the world." (이어 그는 “경주에서 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령과 이재명 대통령은 우리 동맹의 새로운 장을 열었다”며 “우리는 (한미)동맹에 대한 트럼프 대통령의 비전을 함께 실현해 나갈 것이며, (동맹은) 그 어느 때보다 더 강력하고, 안전하며, 번영할 것”이라고 말했다. 아울러 스틸 대사는 “우리 동맹은 전쟁에서 다져졌고, 자유를 수호하기 위해 어깨를 나란히 한 이들의 피를 통해 확보했다”며 “오늘 한미동맹은 세계에서 가장 강력한 동맹 중 하나”라고 한미동맹의 중요성을 거듭 강조했다.)

Ambassador Steel’s mention of Gyeongju appears to underscore the follow-up implementation of agreements, such as tariff negotiations, reached during the U.S.-ROK summit held in Gyeongju, North Gyeongsang Province, in October of last year on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) meeting. Going forward, Ambassador Steel is expected to play a key role in the implementation phase of agreements made by the two leaders, including U.S. investment commitments, security cooperation negotiations, and shipbuilding collaboration. Particular attention is being paid to how Ambassador Steel will communicate with the South Korean government on the issue of the Coupang personal data breach, which has been cited as a potential obstacle to bilateral cooperation. However, concerns remain that Ambassador Steel, a conservative-leaning figure with a hardline stance on North Korea and China, may clash with the Lee Jae-myung administration in conveying the demands of the Trump administration. <<> Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Park Il said on the same day, "We expect Ambassador Steel, based on her understanding of the U.S.-ROK alliance and bilateral relations, to make meaningful contributions to strengthening the alliance and enhancing friendship between the peoples of both countries." He added, "There are many issues to collaborate on between South Korea and the U.S. at this point. Since Ambassador Steel has been appointed after a vacancy of over a year, we anticipate much more effective and close diplomatic communication between the two sides." <<> Meanwhile, outside the airport, a protest was held by a civic group opposing Ambassador Steel’s appointment. About a dozen members of the "2026 August 15 Independent Peace March Promotion Committee" held banners reading "Coupang Protector Michelle Steel, Get Out" and chanted slogans as her vehicle departed. In contrast, about a dozen individuals, believed to be YouTube streamers and members of far-right groups, waved Korean national flags and U.S. flags, welcoming Ambassador Steel’s arrival and shouting at the opposing group, leading to heated exchanges. <<> Reported by Jang Ye-ji and Park Min-hee, Senior Correspondent. Email: penj@hani.co.kr (스틸 대사의 경주 관련 언급은 지난해 10월 경북 경주에서 아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC)를 계기로 열린 한미 정상회담에서 합의한 관세협상 등의 후속 이행을 강조한 것으로 보인다. 앞으로 스틸 대사는 대미투자 이행과 한미 안보 분야 협상, 조선 협력 등 양국 정상이 합의한 사안의 이행 국면에서 주요한 역할을 할 것으로 전망된다. 특히 한미 협력에 걸림돌로 꼽히는 쿠팡 개인정보 유출 사건 문제를 두고 스틸 대사가 한국 정부와 어떠한 소통을 이어갈지 주목된다. 다만 북한과 중국에 강경한 입장을 보이는 보수 성향의 스틸 대사가 트럼프 행정부의 요구를  전달하는 과정에서 이재명 정부와 갈등을 빚을 수 있다는 우려도 있다.)

item.title: [Photo] Michelle Steel, first US ambassador to South Korea under second Trump administration, arrives… Progressive groups stage surprise protest ([포토] 트럼프 2기 첫 주한미대사 미셸 스틸 입국…진보단체, 반대 기습시위)
item.description:
Michelle Steel, the first US ambassador to South Korea under the second Donald Trump administration, arrived at Incheon International Airport Terminal 2 on the 30th. (미국 도널드 트럼프 2기 행정부의 첫 주한미국대사인 미셸 스틸 대사가 30일 인천국제공항 제2터미널을 통해 입국했다.)

In her first briefing upon arriving at Incheon International Airport that afternoon, Ambassador Steel stated, "The ROK-US alliance has repeatedly proven its value based on long-standing trust and is one of the most powerful alliances in the world today." Ambassador Michelle Steel, nominated as the first Korean-American female US ambassador to South Korea, was born in Seoul in 1955 as a second-generation displaced person and is a former politician who was twice elected to the U.S. House of Representatives for California in 2020 and 2022. (스틸 대사는 이날 오후 인천국제공항으로 입국하며 가진 첫 브리핑에서 “한미동맹은 오랜 신뢰를 바탕으로 거듭 그 가치를 입증해 왔으며, 오늘날 세계에서 가장 강력한 동맹 가운데 하나”라는 입장을 밝혔다. 한국계 첫 여성 주한미국대사로 지명된 미셸 스틸 대사는 1955년 서울에서 태어난 실향민 2세로 2020년과 2022년 캘리포니아주 연방하원의원에 두 차례 당선된 정치인 출신이다.)

On this day, activists from the 'August 15 Peace March' steering committee held a press conference in front of the VIP room of Incheon Airport Terminal 2, where Ambassador Michelle Steel arrived, and stated, "We strongly reject Michelle Steel, the US ambassador to South Korea, who promotes war confrontation and interferes in internal affairs." They also claimed, "She is likely to pressure the South Korean government in economic and trade areas such as Coupang and investment in the US, and is a figure who undermines peace on the Korean Peninsula, having repeatedly stated positions such as 'South Korea should support Taiwan if war breaks out' and 'opposing the declaration of an end to the Korean War.'" As Ambassador Michelle Steel was leaving the airport, they staged a surprise protest in the event parking lot of Terminal 2, holding signs reading "Michelle Steel, leave." (이날 ‘8·15자주평화대행진’ 추진위원회 활동가들이 미셜 스틸 대사가 입국한 인천공항 제2여객터미널 귀빈실 앞에서 기자회견을 열고 “전쟁대결을 조장하고, 내정간섭을 일삼는 미셸 스틸 주한미대사를 강력히 거부한다”고 밝혔다. 또 “쿠팡, 대미투자 등 경제·통상분야에 대해 한국정부를 압박할 것으로 보이고, ‘대만 전쟁 발발시 한국이 지원해야한다’거나 ‘한반도 종전선언을 반대한다’는 입장을 여러차례 밝히는 등 한반도 평화를 저해하는 인물”이라고 주장했다. 이들은 미셸 스틸 대사가 공항을 빠져나갈 때 2터미널 행사용 주차장에서 ‘미셸 스틸 나가라’라고 적힌 손팻말을 들고 기습 시위를 벌이기도 했다.)

Park Jong-sik, reporter anaki@hani.co.kr (박종식 기자 anaki@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Government's 'Substantial Contribution' to the Strait of Hormuz Depends on Iran-Oman Negotiations (정부 호르무즈해협 ‘실질적 기여’, 이란-오만 협상에 달려)
item.description:
As the government reviews a "substantial contribution plan" for stabilizing the Strait of Hormuz, the ongoing negotiations between Iran and Oman are expected to be a key variable. (정부가 호르무즈해협 안정화를 위한 ‘실질적 기여 방안’을 검토하고 있는 가운데, 현재 진행중인 이란-오만의 협상이 주요 변수가 될 것으로 보인다.)

On the 30th, the presidential office stated in response to reports that "the government is specifically considering deploying surveillance aircraft and other assets to the Strait of Hormuz" that "there has been no recent request from the U.S. side for the deployment of specific assets." It further explained, "The government has been closely monitoring the escalating tensions in the Middle East and has actively participated in international efforts to swiftly normalize global maritime logistics networks. We are reviewing practical contribution measures by comprehensively considering all factors, including readiness on the Korean Peninsula and domestic legal procedures." (30일 청와대는 ‘정부가 호르무즈해협에 초계기 등의 파견을 구체적으로 검토중’이라는 보도에 대해 “최근 미측으로부터 구체적인 특정 자산 파견을 요청받은 바 없다”고 밝혔다. 이어 “정부는 중동 내 긴장 고조 상황을 면밀히 주시하며 글로벌 해상 물류망의 조속한 정상화를 위한 국제적 노력에 적극 참여해왔고 실질적인 기여 방안에 대해 한반도 대비 태세와 국내법 절차 등 제반 요인을 종합적으로 감안하여 검토하고 있다”고 설명했다.)

A foreign ministry official also said on the same day, "South Korea and the U.S. have been communicating for a long time (about contributions to the Strait of Hormuz)," but added, "What matters most now is the stabilization of the Strait of Hormuz." This emphasizes the government's stance that a concrete and substantial contribution can only be made if armed clashes cease in the Middle East, including the Strait of Hormuz, a ceasefire or end to hostilities between the U.S. and Iran is restored, and an environment is created where Iran cooperates in stabilizing the strait. The official stated, "Not only South Korea but the entire international community is paying close attention to the ongoing discussions between Iran and Oman regarding the Strait of Hormuz." (외교부 당국자도 이날 “한미간에는 (호르무즈해협에 대한 기여에 대해) 오래 전부터 소통을 해왔다”면서도 “지금 가장 중요한 건 호르무즈해협이 안정화되는 게 무엇보다 중요하다”고 말했다. 호르무즈해협을 비롯한 중동 일대에 무력 공방이 없어져야 하고, 나아가 미국과 이란 간 휴전 내지 종전 상황이 복원돼야 하며, 이란이 해협 안정에 협조하는 환경이 조성돼야 정부가 구체적이고 실질적인 기여를 할 수 있다는 입장을 강조한 것이다. 이 당국자는 “우리뿐 아니라 모든 국제사회가 현재 진행중인 이란과 오만의 호르무즈 해협 관련 논의에 굉장히 주목하고 있다”고 말했다.)

According to diplomatic sources and foreign media reports, Oman is known to have proposed a plan to ensure free navigation by having Iran manage the northern route of the Strait of Hormuz and Oman manage the route on its side. It is reported that Oman proposed allowing Iran to autonomously collect service fees from ships using the strait, instead of Iran solely controlling the Strait of Hormuz. However, Iran has rejected Oman's proposal and instead suggested expanding its control zone all the way to Oman's side. The international community is closely watching whether the two sides can narrow this gap. (외교 소식통들과 외신 보도에 따르면, 오만은 호르무즈해협의 북쪽 항로는 이란이 관리하고, 오만쪽 항로는 오만이 관리하는 식으로 자유로운 통항이 이뤄지는 방안을 제안한 것으로 알려졌다. 오만은 이란이 호르무즈해협을 단독으로 통제하지 않는 대신 해협을 이용하는 선박으로부터 자율적으로 서비스 요금을 거두는 방식을 제안했다고 한다. 하지만 이란은 오만의 제안을 거절하고 자국의 통제구역을 오만 쪽으로까지 확대하는 제안을 한 상황이다. 양쪽이 이 차이를 좁힐 수 있을지 국제사회가 주시하고 있다.)

Even if an agreement between Iran and Oman is reached, a second obstacle—mine clearance—remains. Since Iran is likely to object if a multinational task force enters the strait for mine removal, persuading Iran is a key challenge. (이란-오만의 합의가 이뤄진다고 해도 기뢰 제거라는 두번째 장애물이 남아 있다. 기뢰 제거를 위해 다국적 임무단이 해협에 들어가려면 이란이 반발할 가능성이 크기 때문에 이란을 설득하는 것이 주요한 과제다.)

Regarding these difficulties, the international community's plan for stabilizing the Strait of Hormuz is that, if a U.S.-Iran-Oman agreement is reached, the next step would involve a multinational task force led by countries like the U.K. and France entering the southern Omani route to clear mines. The U.S. and the U.K. were scheduled to hold a high-level defense officials' meeting soon to establish a multinational coalition to secure safe commercial navigation in the Strait of Hormuz, but this meeting has reportedly been postponed. It appears the meeting was delayed to first observe progress in the Iran-Oman negotiations. (이런 난제들에 대해 미국-이란-오만의 합의가 이뤄지면 다음 단계로 영국·프랑스 등이 주도하는 다국적 임무단이 남쪽 오만 항로에 진입해 기뢰를 제거한다는 방안이 국제사회의 호르무즈해협 안정화 구상이다. 미국과 영국은 호르무즈해협의 상업 운항 안전 확보를 위한 다국적 연합체를 창설하기 위한 국방 당국 고위급 회의를 곧 열 예정이었지만, 이 회의는 일단 연기된 것으로 알려졌다. 이란과 오만 협상 추이를 먼저 지켜보기 위해 회의가 미뤄진 것으로 보인다.)

The government has been communicating directly with the U.S. regarding a substantial contribution to the Strait of Hormuz while also consistently participating in discussions on the task force concept led by the U.K. and France. President Lee Jae-myung also stated during a virtual summit attended by about 50 countries last April, "South Korea imports approximately 70% of its crude oil through the Strait of Hormuz and is a key stakeholder," expressing a "willingness to make a substantial contribution." (정부는 호르무즈해협에 대한 실질적 기여를 위해 미국과 직접 소통하는 한편 영국·프랑스 주도의 임무단 구상 논의에도 꾸준히 참여해왔다. 이재명 대통령도 지난 4월 50여개국이 참여한 화상 정상회의에서 “한국은 원유의 약 70%를 호르무즈해협을 통해 수입하는 핵심 이해 당사국”이라며 “실질적 기여 의지”를 밝혔다.)

Regarding whether the U.S. has recently made a specific request for military contributions to South Korea, a foreign ministry official said on the same day, "There is no new demand." During a press conference after a South Korea-U.S.-Japan foreign ministers' meeting at the ASEAN foreign ministers' meeting held in Manila, Philippines, on the 22nd, Secretary of State Rubio was asked if he had requested contributions of naval assets for the Strait of Hormuz. He answered, "I did not make such a request today." However, he added, "I think (supporting naval assets) would also benefit Asian allies because they heavily rely on oil and natural gas supplied from the Middle East." (미국이 최근 한국에 군사적 기여를 구체적으로 요청했느냐에 대해 외교부 당국자는 이날 “최근 새로운 요구가 있는 것은 아니다”라고 말했다. 지난 22일 필리핀 마닐라에서 열린 아세안(ASEAN·동남아시아국가연합) 외교장관회의에서 한·미·일 외교장관 회담을 한 뒤 루비오 장관은 호르무즈해협 해군 자산 기여를 요청했느냐는 질문에 “오늘 그런 요청을 하지는 않았다”고 답했다. 그러면서도 “(해군 자산 지원은) 아시아 동맹국에도 이익이 되는 일이라고 생각한다. 그들은 중동에서 공급되는 석유와 천연가스에 크게 의존하고 있기 때문”이라고 말했다.)

With complex challenges piling up in recent U.S.-South Korea relations, including delays in U.S. investment and the Coupang issue, there are also predictions that the government may seek a more active contribution to stabilizing the Strait of Hormuz. (최근 한미관계에 대미투자 지연, 쿠팡 문제를 비롯해 복잡한 과제들이 누적된 상황에서, 정부가 호르무즈해협 안정화에 대해 좀 더 적극적인 기여를 하려 할 것이라는 전망도 나오고 있다.)

Senior Reporter Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr (박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "Why Did You Lose?" Directed at Hong Myung-bo… The National Assembly Hearing More Frustrating Than Football (홍명보 향해 “왜 졌냐?”…축구보다 더 답답한 국회 청문회)
item.description:
At the Korea Football Association hearing held by the National Assembly's Culture, Sports and Tourism Committee on the 30th, ruling and opposition lawmakers grilled former Korea Football Association President Chung Mong-gyu and former national football team coach Hong Myung-bo over the team's poor World Cup performance and association management issues. However, criticism has emerged that the hearing ended up as a "tepid" session, with questions and answers failing to delve into fundamental problems. (30일 국회 문화체육관광위원회가 연 대한축구협회 청문회에서 여야 의원들은 정몽규 전 대한축구협회장, 홍명보 전 축구대표팀 감독 등을 상대로 월드컵 부진과 축구협회 운영 문제 등을 따져 물었다. 하지만 근본적인 문제를 파고들지 못한 질문과 답변이 이어지면서 ‘맹탕’ 청문회에 그쳤다는 지적이 나온다.)

Former President Chung and former coach Hong, who appeared as witnesses that day, bowed their heads side by side. Chung stated, "During my tenure, I did my utmost for the development of Korean football, but I apologize for the series of controversies and the unsatisfactory results at the North and Central America World Cup." Hong also said, "I first apologize to the people for failing to meet their expectations at the North and Central America World Cup. I take heavy responsibility for not repaying the expectations you have placed on the national team." (이날 증인으로 나온 정 전 회장과 홍 전 감독은 나란히 고개를 숙였다. 정 전 회장은 “재임 기간에 한국 축구 발전을 위해 최대한 노력했지만 일련의 논란과 북중미 월드컵의 미흡한 결과에 대해 죄송스럽게 생각한다”고 밝혔다. 홍 전 감독도 “북중미 월드컵에서 국민의 기대에 부응하지 못한 점에 대해 국민 여러분께 먼저 죄송하다는 말씀을 드린다. 그동안 대표팀에 보내주신 기대에 보답하지 못한 책임을 무겁게 받아들이고 있다”고 말했다.)

However, they actively refuted the allegations raised. When lawmaker Bae Hyun-jin of the People Power Party questioned whether there was a "disregard for procedures and backroom dealings in the coach selection process," Hong explained, "When I was offered the coaching position, I believed it followed normal procedures. Even though meeting (former technical director Lee Im-saeng) in front of my house might lead the public to view it as opaque, I have never demanded any special favors or benefits just because we met there." (하지만 이들은 제기된 의혹에 적극적으로 반박했다. 배현진 국민의힘 의원이 “감독 선임 과정에서 절차적 무시와 밀실 행정이 있었다”고 질문하자 홍 전 감독은 “저한테 (감독) 제안이 왔을 때 저는 정상적 절차를 거쳤다고 생각했다. 집 앞에서 (이임생 전 기술총괄이사를) 만난 게 국민께서 불투명하다고 생각은 하실 수 있다고 생각하지만, 저는 집 앞에서 만났다고 해서 어떤 특혜나 이익을 요구한 적이 없다”고 해명했다.)

When lawmaker Im O-kyung of the Democratic Party pressed, "Have you ever heard terms like 'Hyundai Football Association' or 'Korea University cartel'? Why do people say that if the president or coach isn't from Korea University, they can't even set foot in the association?" Chung countered, "Out of the 25 men's national team coaches I appointed, only one was from Korea University, and none of the over 20 women's national team coaches were from Korea University." (임오경 더불어민주당 의원이 “‘현대축구협회’ ‘고대 카르텔’이란 말을 들어본 적이 있느냐. 회장도, 감독도 고대 출신이 아니면 협회에 발도 못 딛는다는 말이 왜 나오느냐”고 따지자 정 전 회장은 “제가 임명한 남자 대표팀 감독 25명 중 고대 출신은 1명이고, 여자 대표팀 감독 20여명 중 고대 출신은 없다”고 반박했다.)

Regarding suspicions of internal conflict when players refused media interviews during the World Cup, Hong explained, "It wasn't significant enough to impact the team." As for excluding Son Heung-min and Lee Jae-sung from the starting lineup for the group stage's third match against South Africa, he said, "It was a tactical decision." (월드컵 기간 중 선수단이 언론 인터뷰를 거부하면서 팀 내 갈등이 불거진 것 아니냐는 의혹에 대해 홍 전 감독은 “팀에 영향을 줄 정도로 큰 것은 아니었다”고 해명했다. 조별리그 3차전 남아프리카공화국전 선발 명단에서 손흥민과 이재성을 뺀 것을 두고는 “전술적 판단이었다”고 말했다.)

When lawmaker Choi Min-hee of the Democratic Party asked whether Son Heung-min and others not starting was a form of retaliation by Hong, national team coach Kim Jin-kyu, also a witness, said, "There was nothing like that at all," adding, "I don't think we lost the game because Lee Jae-sung and Son Heung-min didn't play." When Choi then pressed, "So why did you lose?" Kim replied, "It's a bit difficult for me to explain here why we won or lost." (‘손흥민 등이 선발 출전하지 못한 게 홍 전 감독의 보복 차원이었느냐’는 최민희 민주당 의원의 질문에 증인으로 나온 김진규 대표팀 코치도 “그런 건 전혀 없었다”며 “이재성, 손흥민 선수가 안 뛰어서 경기를 졌다고 생각하지는 않는다”고 말했다. 이에 최 의원이 “그러면 왜 졌냐”고 따지자 김 코치는 “왜 이겼냐 졌냐를 여기서 말씀드리기에는 조금 곤란하다”고 말했다.)

The hearing has drawn widespread criticism as insufficient. Many of the lawmakers' questions either reiterated points from the September 2024 National Assembly audit or earlier media reports, or strayed from the core issues. The absence of key witnesses—such as former KFA technical director Lee Im-saeng and former KFA vice president Park Hang-seo, who could have shed light on the coach selection process—further weakened the session. (이날 청문회를 두고 미흡했다는 평가가 쏟아졌다. 의원들 질의 중 상당수는 2024년 9월 국회 국정감사, 기존 언론 보도 등을 통해 나온 것을 다시 언급하거나 핵심을 벗어난 내용이었다. 감독 선임 과정을 밝힐 핵심 증인인 이임생 전 축구협회 기술총괄이사, 박항서 전 축구협회 부회장 등이 불출석한 것도 힘을 빠지게 했다.)

Senior Correspondent Kim Chang-geum kimck@hani.co.kr Reporter Son Hyun-soo boysoo@hani.co.kr (김창금 선임기자 kimck@hani.co.kr 손현수 기자 boysoo@hani.co.kr)

item.title: 'Prosecutor's Supplementary Investigation Authority Abolition' Criminal Procedure Act Presented to Plenary… People Power Party Filibustering (‘검사 보완수사권 폐지’ 형소법 본회의 상정…국힘, 필리버스터)
item.description:
The National Assembly held a plenary session on the 30th and passed the 'Special Investigation Act on the National Election Commission to Uncover the Truth behind the Ballot Shortage Incident' with bipartisan agreement. On the same day, the National Assembly, led by the Democratic Party of Korea, also presented a revised Criminal Procedure Act that abolishes the prosecutor's supplementary investigation authority to the plenary session. The People Power Party opposed the abolition of the supplementary investigation authority and launched a filibuster (unlimited debate). (국회가 30일 본회의를 열어 ‘투표용지 부족 사태 진상규명을 위한 선관위 특검법’을 여야 합의로 의결했다. 이날 국회는 더불어민주당 주도로 검사의 보완수사권을 폐지하는 형사소송법 개정안도 본회의에 상정했다. 국민의힘은 보완수사권 폐지에 반발하며 필리버스터(무제한 토론)에 나섰다.)

The National Assembly held a plenary session and presented the 'Act on the Appointment of a Special Prosecutor to Uncover the Truth behind Allegations of Infringement on Citizens' Right to Vote, including the Ballot Shortage Incident during the 9th Nationwide Simultaneous Local Elections,' which was approved with 226 votes in favor out of 228 members present. (국회는 이날 본회의를 열고 ‘제9회 전국동시지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태 등 국민참정권 침해 의혹 진상규명을 위한 특별검사의 임명 등에 관한 법률’을 상정해 재석 의원 228명 중 226명의 찬성으로 의결했다.)

Afterwards, when the revised Criminal Procedure Act, which abolishes the prosecutor's supplementary investigation authority and expands the reasons for dismissal of indictments by the court, was presented as an agenda item, the People Power Party immediately began a filibuster. Rep. Joo Ho-young of the People Power Party, serving his sixth term, took the floor as the first speaker of the filibuster. (이후 검사의 보완수사권을 폐지하고 법원의 공소기각 사유를 확대하는 내용의 형사소송법 개정안을 안건으로 상정하자, 국민의힘은 곧바로 필리버스터를 시작했다. 6선의 주호영 국민의힘 의원이 필리버스터 첫 주자로 나섰다.)

The Democratic Party stated that the revised Criminal Procedure Act is "a law that protects the safety of the people." Democratic Party floor leader Han Byung-do said at a general meeting of lawmakers before the plenary session, "Under the grand principle of separating investigation and prosecution, the Democratic Party has meticulously supplemented (the bill) to ensure no harm comes to the people," adding, "We will break through the People Power Party's shield and establish a new criminal justice system that protects only the people's human rights and safety today." (민주당은 형사소송법 개정안이 “국민의 안전을 지키는 법”이라고 밝혔다. 한병도 민주당 원내대표는 본회의 전 의원총회에서 “민주당은 수사·기소 분리라는 대원칙하에 국민 피해가 발생하지 않도록 섬세하게 (법안을) 보완해왔다”며 “국민의힘의 방패를 뚫고 오직 국민의 인권과 안전을 지키는 새로운 형사사법체계를 오늘 바로 세우겠다”고 했다.)

The People Power Party held a 'Rally Condemning the Forced Handling of the Abolition of Supplementary Investigation Authority' in front of the plenary hall ahead of the afternoon plenary session, protesting that it is "a law that abandons the safety of the people." People Power Party floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik said, "If the bill passes the plenary session, President Lee Jae-myung must surely exercise his veto power," adding, "Otherwise, all damage will be the people's share, all pain will be the victims' share, and all responsibility will be the Lee Jae-myung administration's share." (국민의힘은 이날 오후 본회의 개의에 앞서 본회의장 앞에서 ‘보완수사권 폐지 강행처리 규탄대회’를 열고 “국민의 안전을 포기하는 법”이라고 반발했다. 정점식 국민의힘 원내대표는 “법안이 본회의를 통과하면 이재명 대통령은 반드시 거부권을 행사해야 한다”며 “그렇지 않으면 모든 피해는 국민 몫이고, 모든 고통은 피해자 몫이고, 모든 책임은 이재명 정권 몫”이라고 했다.)

The Democratic Party plans to end the filibuster through a vote on the afternoon of the 31st and process the revised Criminal Procedure Act. (민주당은 31일 오후 필리버스터를 표결로 종결하고 형사소송법 개정안을 처리할 예정이다.)

Reporter Jo Hee-yeon (조희연 기자 choh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: PPP lawmaker sends "I'm sorry" text to Chung Mong-kyu at hearing (청문회 온 정몽규에 “송구합니다” 문자 보낸 국힘 의원)
item.description:
<<>> People Power Party lawmaker Yun Yong-geun was caught on camera sending an apology text to former Korea Football Association (KFA) chief Chung Mong-kyu, who appeared as a witness at the National Assembly's Culture, Sports and Tourism Committee hearing on the KFA on the 30th, sparking controversy. The text read: "I should have taken better care of you... I'm sorry." <<> The photo shows Yun, a member of the committee, texting Chung that afternoon: "Chairman, this is PPP lawmaker Yun Yong-geun. I received a call from Senior Chung yesterday. I should have taken better care of you... I'm sorry." Chung replied: "Thank you for your concern. I'll greet you in a different setting, not here. Sincerely, Chung Mong-kyu." The committee had convened the hearing, summoning former head coach Hong Myung-bo and former chairman Chung as witnesses, to scrutinize overall operational issues of the KFA following the national football team's elimination in the round of 32 at the 2026 FIFA World Cup in North and Central America. <<> After the exchange of texts was revealed, Committee Chairperson Lee Jae-jung pressed Chung, asking, "During the hearing preparations, did you contact any committee members to lobby?" He then apologized, saying, "If this has become an issue, I feel quite sorry." <<> Yun explained, "Looking at the time, I sent that text before the afternoon session, after the morning questioning, because I have a personal acquaintance with him and felt sorry for not being considerate enough." Who is this Senior Chung, that he can use a network among lawmakers to undermine the hearing?" Chung responded, "Do I have an obligation to reveal that? It involves personal privacy, so I'm not sure if I should say," adding, "He is currently retired." <<> Reporters: Ko Kyung-ju goh@hani.co.kr, Cho Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr ()

item.title: Democrats: "Dismissal of Indictment Reflects Supreme Court Precedent" – People Power Party: "The Result of a Political Backroom Deal" (여 “공소기각, 대법 판례 반영” 야 “정치적 뒷거래 결과물”)
item.description:
Controversy continues over a proposed revision to the Criminal Procedure Act, pushed by the Democratic Party of Korea, which includes adding grounds for a court to dismiss an indictment. The Democratic Party claims it merely "clearly reflects in law the legal principles established by the Supreme Court," while the People Power Party attacks it as "the result of a political backroom deal between President Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party." <<> Legislators from the Democratic Party, the Fatherland Innovation Party, and the Progressive Party, all members of the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee, held a press conference at the National Assembly Communication Center on the 30th, stating, "Dismissal of an indictment is not a newly created system" and arguing, "The People Power Party is pushing false narratives without even properly reviewing the bill." They cited Supreme Court rulings from 2008 (dismissing an indictment in a sting operation involving police arranging karaoke hostesses) and 2021 (dismissing an indictment for retaliatory prosecution against Mr. Yoo Woo-seong, a victim of the Seoul City spy fabrication case by prosecutors), saying, "These precedents are included in the amendment co-proposed by Democratic Party lawmaker Kim Yong-min and Fatherland Innovation Party lawmaker Park Eun-jung, which underwent five plenary committee meetings and nine subcommittee reviews for bills." This content was not in the amendment submitted by the Democratic Party's Task Force on Criminal Procedure Act revision, which was adopted as party policy, but was included after sufficient discussion. Earlier, People Power Party Floor Leader Jeong Jeom-sik, at a Supreme Council meeting of the National Assembly, said regarding the addition of grounds for dismissal of an indictment in the Criminal Procedure Act, "This is the result of a political backroom deal" and added, "To cancel President Lee's criminal trials, they intend to establish a 'dismissal of indictment court' as the second season of the 'Prosecutor-withdrawal Special Counsel'." <<> Article 327 of the Criminal Procedure Act stipulates that a court's decision to dismiss an indictment is made when there is no jurisdiction over the defendant or when the indictment procedure violates the law. The amendment adds further grounds, such as "when the indictment is based on a serious illegal investigation" or "when the indictment represents a clear abuse of prosecutorial discretion." <<> Records show that the first subcommittee of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee's Bill Review Division actually placed the amendment by lawmakers Kim and Park, along with the Democratic Party's TF proposal, on the table and reviewed the clause adding grounds for dismissal of an indictment. During the third meeting of the subcommittee on the 15th, Vice-Chief of the Court Administration Office, Ki Woo-jong, responded that they would "actively accept" the provision, and meeting minutes show Subcommittee Chair Kim Seung-won requesting "a report on expected changes and necessary supplements upon introduction." The subcommittee's bill review materials also include opinions from the Ministry of Justice, stating concern that "procedural arguments would excessively increase over substantive fact-finding, leading to practical side effects like trial delays," and from the Supreme Prosecutors' Office, saying that "whether an indictment is dismissed would likely vary depending on the court's interpretation, impairing predictability and legal stability." A Democratic Party lawmaker from the subcommittee explained, "We prepared an alternative centered on the secretaries' office," and added, "The dismissal of indictment provision was not a contentious issue." <<> However, even within the Democratic Party, there are criticisms that, following recent controversy over National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik's remarks about a constitutional amendment allowing a sitting president's re-election, highlighting the expanded grounds for dismissal of an indictment is fueling unnecessary debate. A first-term lawmaker from the Seoul metropolitan area said, "The situation has been framed as if politics revolves around resolving the president's legal risks through withdrawal of prosecution or re-election – did we really have to push this now?" <<> Opinions in the legal community are divided on the impact this provision will have on trial practice. A presiding judge at a court in the Seoul metropolitan area remarked, "Since content that existed in precedents has been put into the Criminal Procedure Act, it indeed makes it easier for judges to write rulings dismissing an indictment with less burden." In contrast, a judge at a court in Seoul predicted, "Applying abstract statutory language in rulings won't have significant effect, so in practice, there won't be much difference." <<> Reporter Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr Reporter Choi Ha-yan chy@hani.co.kr Reporter Im Cheol-hwi jhm@hani.co.kr (더불어민주당이 추진하는 형사소송법 개정안에 법원의 공소기각 사유를 추가하는 내용이 포함된 것을 두고 논란이 이어지고 있다. 민주당은 “대법원이 확립한 법리를 법률에 명확히 반영한 것뿐”이란 입장인 반면, 국민의힘은 “이재명 대통령과 민주당의 정치적 뒷거래 결과물”이라고 공세를 폈다.)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae and Kim Min-seok in Close Polls… 'Public Opinion' and 'Party Supporters' Show Different Results (정청래·김민석 여론조사 혼전…‘국민여론’ ‘당지지층’ 엇갈려)
item.description:
Candidates for the leadership of the Democratic Party of Korea in the August 17 party convention are closely watching poll results that show a tight race. (더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회 당권 주자들이 혼전 양상을 보이는 여론조사 결과에 촉각을 곤두세우고 있다.)

According to a National Barometer Survey (NBS) conducted by Embrain Public, K-Stat Research, Korea Research, and Hankook Research from August 27 to 29, targeting 1,000 adults aged 18 and over via telephone interviews (with a 95% confidence level and a margin of error of ±3.1 percentage points), Jung Cheong-rae was favored as the next Democratic Party leader by 21% of respondents, Kim Min-seok by 19%, and Song Young-gil by 6%. 54% of respondents were undecided, including those who said "none" or "don't know/refused to answer." Among Democratic Party supporters, Kim received 34% and Jung 29%, with Song at 9%. (엠브레인퍼블릭·케이스탯리서치·코리아리서치·한국리서치가 지난 27~29일 만 18살 이상 1천명을 대상으로 전화면접조사를 진행한 전국지표조사(NBS) 결과(신뢰 수준 95%, 표본오차 ±3.1%포인트), 차기 민주당 대표로 적합한 인물로 정청래 후보가 21%, 김민석 후보가 19%, 송영길 후보가 6%로 집계됐다. 없음, 모름·무응답 등 태도 유보는 54%였다. 민주당 지지층을 대상으로 한 조사에서는 김 후보가 34%, 정 후보가 29%였다. 송 후보는 9%로 집계됐다.)

A Media Tomato poll released on the same day showed a similar trend. In a survey conducted by Media Tomato on August 27-28 via wireless automated response (ARS) targeting 1,033 adults aged 18 and over (with a 95% confidence level and a margin of error of ±3 percentage points), Jung received 36.9% as the top preference for the next Democratic Party leader, leading Kim (28%) outside the margin of error. Song received 9.2%, with 21.8% saying "none" and 4.1% saying "don't know." Among Democratic Party supporters, Kim led with 44.9%, followed by Jung at 38.9% and Song at 11.2%. (For details, refer to the website of the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission.) (이날 발표된 미디어토마토 여론조사도 비슷한 흐름을 보였다. 미디어토마토가 27~28일 만 18살 이상 1033명을 대상으로 무선자동응답(ARS) 조사를 진행한 결과(신뢰 수준 95%, 표본오차 ±3%포인트)에서 민주당 차기 당대표 1순위 선호도는 정 후보가 36.9%로 김 후보(28%)를 오차범위 밖에서 앞섰다. 송 후보는 9.2%로 나타났다. 없음은 21.8%, ‘잘 모름’은 4.1%였다. 민주당 지지층을 대상으로 한 조사에서는 김 후보가 44.9%, 정 후보는 38.9%였다. 송 후보는 11.2%로 뒤를 이었다.(자세한 내용은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 누리집 참조))

As poll results showing a tight battle between Jung and Kim are released one after another, interpretations differ between the camps regarding the fact that "general public opinion" favors Jung while "Democratic Party supporters" favor Kim. The party leader candidate selection combines 70% votes from enrolled party members and national delegates with 30% from public opinion polls. A source from Jung's camp said, "We need to look at the trend. While Kim was ahead in earlier polls, the trend has now shifted to Jung leading. We've definitely caught an upward momentum." In contrast, a lawmaker supporting Kim stated, "It's true that negative attacks, like those related to Shincheonji, have softened the support base and narrowed the gap," but added, "Kim consistently and solidly leads among Democratic Party supporters and independents." Attention is also focused on how the preferential voting system, where voters rank candidates from 1st to 3rd, might affect the final outcome. In the Media Tomato poll, when asked for second preferences, Song received 33.9%, Kim 12.9%, and Jung 9%. (정 후보와 김 후보가 각축전을 벌이는 여론조사 결과가 잇따라 발표되는 가운데 ‘국민 여론’은 정 후보, ‘민주당 지지층’은 김 후보를 선호하는 결과가 나오는 것을 두고 캠프별 해석이 엇갈린다. 당대표 후보자는 권리당원·전국대의원 70%와 국민여론조사 30%를 합산하도록 한다. 정 후보 쪽 관계자는 “추세를 봐야 한다”며 “예전 조사에서 김 후보가 앞섰다면 지금은 정 후보가 앞서는 흐름으로 바뀌었다. 확실히 상승 흐름을 탔다”고 했다. 반면, 김 후보를 돕는 의원은 “신천지 등 네거티브 공방으로 지지층의 연성화가 생기면서 간격이 좁혀진 건 사실”이라면서도 “민주당 지지층과 무당층에서 김 후보가 앞서는 건 일관되고 견고한 흐름”이라고 풀이했다. 1~3순위를 적어 내는 선호투표제가 최종 결과에 미칠 영향도 주목하고 있다. 미디어토마토 조사에서 2순위 선호도를 물어보면 송 후보가 33.9%, 김 후보 12.9%, 정 후보 9% 순이었다.)

The Democratic Party's regional primary elections for the convention will kick off on September 1 in South Chungcheong, North Chungcheong, Sejong, and Daejeon, followed by Busan, Ulsan, and South Gyeongsang on September 2. On that day, Kim and Jung focused their campaigns on Jeju and Incheon, where delegate and enrolled party member voting begins on September 4, while Song toured the Honam region, where about one-third of enrolled party members are concentrated. (민주당 전당대회 지역 순회 경선은 새달 1일 충남·충북·세종·대전, 2일 부산·울산·경남 지역 순회 경선을 시작으로 막을 올린다. 이날 김 후보와 정 후보는 새달 4일부터 대의원·권리당원 투표가 시작되는 제주·인천 지역 선거운동에 집중했고, 송 후보는 권리당원 3분의 1 가량이 모여 있는 호남 지역을 훑었다.)

By Ko Han-sol, Reporter sol@hani.co.kr (고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Ruling Party-Policy Meeting: Voices of Concern Over "Super-Luxury Housing Ownership Tax Hike May Spark Tax Resistance" (당정 협의서 “초고가 주택 보유세 인상 조세 저항 우려” 목소리)
item.description:
Ahead of the release of the second tax reform plan under the Lee Jae-myung administration early next month, in a closed-door ruling party-policy meeting held on the 30th, ruling party lawmakers reportedly expressed concerns that the government’s real estate tax overhaul measures, including an increase in ownership taxes on super-luxury homes, could trigger tax resistance. (새달 초 이재명 정부 두 번째 세제개편안 발표를 앞두고 30일 이뤄진 당정 비공개 간담회에서 여당 의원들이 초고가 주택 보유세 인상 등 정부의 부동산 세제 개편 방안이 조세 저항을 부를 수 있다며 우려를 전달한 것으로 전해졌다.)

The Democratic Party of Korea and the government held a closed-door ruling party-policy consultation meeting at the National Assembly on the morning of that day to discuss the government’s upcoming tax reform plan for this year. The meeting, conducted behind closed doors, was attended by Acting Leader and Floor Leader Han Byung-do, Budget and Settlement Special Committee Chair Lee Kwang-jae, Strategy and Finance Committee Chair Cho Seung-rae, and other ruling party members of the Strategy and Finance Committee. From the government side, Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Economy and Finance Koo Yoon-cheol and other officials from the ministry participated. The reform plan is reported to include measures to increase the tax burden on super-luxury and non-occupied homes. (더불어민주당과 정부는 이날 오전 국회에서 비공개 당정협의회를 열어 정부가 조만간 발표할 예정인 올해 세제개편안에 대해 논의했다. 비공개로 열린 이날 회의에는 한병도 대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표와 이광재 국회 예산결산특별위원회 위원장, 조승래 재정경제기획위원회 위원장과 여당 재경위원 등이 참석했다. 정부에서는 구윤철 부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관과 재경부 관계자들이 참석했다. 개편안에는 초고가·비거주 주택 등에 대한 세 부담 강화 방안이 담긴 것으로 전해진다.)

Some attendees from the ruling party conveyed concerns during the meeting about the government’s plan to strengthen real estate taxation. One attendee said, “We expressed the view that since once announced, it cannot be taken back, we hope the government designs a more precise plan considering the anticipated tax resistance,” adding, “With home prices also expected to rise, the experience of failure during the Moon Jae-in administration should not be repeated.” There are concerns that the combination of rising home prices and heavier ownership taxes during the previous Moon administration led to a rapid increase in tax burdens, and the resulting strong tax resistance faced by the government and ruling party could recur ahead of the 2028 general elections. (여당 쪽 일부 참석자들은 회의에서 정부의 부동산 과세 강화 방안에 대해 우려의 목소리를 전했다. 한 참석자는 “일단 발표하고 나면 거두어들일 수 없으니 향후 예상되는 조세 저항을 고려해 더욱 정밀한 방안을 설계했으면 좋겠다는 뜻을 전했다”며 “집값 상승세도 예상되는 상황에서 문재인 정부 때 실패 경험을 되풀이해선 안 된단 생각”이라고 말했다. 과거 문재인 정부 당시 집값 상승 흐름과 보유세 부담 강화 정책이 겹치며 세 부담액이 빠르게 늘고, 이에 정부·여당이 거센 조세 저항에 직면했던 일이 2028년 총선을 앞두고 재연될 수도 있단 우려다.)

Ruling party lawmakers from the greater capital region are also closely watching public sentiment following the tax reform plan’s announcement. One senior lawmaker said, “While this may be a policy the government is pushing forward after careful consideration, considering future elections (such as general elections), this is a difficult time to talk about taxes.” (여당 수도권 지역구 의원들도 세제개편안 발표 뒤 여론 향방에 촉각을 곤두세우는 분위기다. 한 중진 의원은 “정부가 고민 끝에 추진하는 정책이겠지만 (추후 총선 등 선거를 고려하면) 지금 세금 얘기를 하기엔 어려운 시기”라고 말했다.)

Meanwhile, at a general meeting of Democratic Party lawmakers held at the National Assembly that day, concerns were also raised about the government’s ongoing push to reform the Local Education Finance Grant. The government is discussing ways to change the method of calculating grants, which currently automatically allocate 20.79% of domestic taxes to city and provincial offices of education. Spokesperson Kim Seong-hoe told reporters after the meeting, “There was an opinion that since education budgets are still insufficient, it would be good if cuts to education funding are not made lightly.” (한편, 이날 국회에서 열린 민주당 의원총회에서 정부에서 추진 중인 지방교육재정교부금 개편에 대한 우려 목소리도 나왔다. 정부는 매년 내국세의 20.79%가 시·도교육청에 자동 배정되는 교부금 산정 방식을 바꾸는 방안을 논의하고 있다. 김성회 원내대변인은 의원총회 뒤 기자들을 만나 “교육 예산이 아직 모자라기 때문에 교육 예산 삭감을 쉽게 결정하지 않았으면 좋겠다는 의견이 있었다”고 전했다.)

item.title: Military Nearly Shot Down US Drone... 'Crane' Alert Issued for North Korean Drone Response (군, 미군 무인기 격추할 뻔…한때 북 무인기 대응 ‘두루미’ 발령)
item.description:
The Joint Chiefs of Staff announced on the 30th that an unidentified aircraft was identified in the afternoon in a region south of the General Outpost (GOP) in northern Gyeonggi Province, which turned out to be a US military drone. The US Forces Korea explained that the incident occurred during joint training between South Korean and US Marine Corps. Military authorities reportedly prepared to shoot down the drone, anticipating it might be a North Korean drone. (합동참모본부(합참)는 30일 오후 경기 북부 지오피(GOP·일반전초) 이남 지역에서 미확인 비행체를 식별해 확인한 결과 미군 소속 무인기로 판명됐다고 밝혔다. 주한미군은 한국과 미국 해병대의 훈련 중에 발생했다고 설명했다. 군 당국은 한때 해당 무인기가 북한 무인기일 것에 대비해 격추까지 대비한 것으로 전해졌다.)

The Joint Chiefs stated that soldiers in the region detected the unidentified aircraft using thermal observation (TOD) equipment, initiated response procedures according to operational protocols, and ended the situation after confirming it was a US military drone during training. A Joint Chiefs official said, "The drone was identified in an area south of the GOP." Military authorities subsequently issued a 'Crane' alert, an operational system that raises air defense readiness across the board. The 'Crane' is a response system for North Korean drone intrusions, mobilizing all nearby air defense assets, including anti-aircraft artillery. This could have led to a major incident of attacking US forces during joint training. (합참은 이날 해당 지역 부대 장병이 열상감시(TOD) 장비로 미확인 비행체를 포착해 작전수행절차에 따라 대응에 들어갔고, 훈련 중인 미군 무인기로 확인한 뒤 상황을 종료했다고 밝혔다. 합참 관계자는 “해당 무인기는 지오피 이남 지역에서 식별됐다”고 말했다. 군 당국은 이에 방공태세를 일제히 격상하는 작전수행체계인 ‘두루미’를 발령했다. ‘두루미’는 북한 무인기 침투에 대비한 작전수행체계로, 발령되면 방공포 등 인근 방공 전력이 총동원된다. 자칫 연합훈련 중인 미군 전력을 공격하는 초대형 사고로 이어질 뻔한 것이다.)

The US Forces Korea confirmed the drone was American in the afternoon, stating, "This incident occurred during joint training between the US Marine Corps and the Republic of Korea Marine Corps 1st Division." They added, "The US Marine Corps is evaluating the circumstances surrounding the incident and continues to coordinate with the Republic of Korea Marine Corps and relevant local authorities." (주한미군은 이날 오후 해당 무인기가 미국 무인기라고 확인하면서 “이번 사건은 미 해병대와 한국 해병대 1사단 간 연합훈련 중 발생했다”고 밝혔다. 또 “미 해병대는 사건을 둘러싼 경위를 평가하고 있으며, 대한민국 해병대 및 관련 지역 당국과 계속 협조하고 있다”고 설명했다.)

While the US Forces Korea claims the drone's flight plan was shared with South Korean forces in advance, South Korean military authorities reportedly maintain they never approved it. This raises observations about potential gaps in information sharing between South Korean and US military authorities. (주한미군 쪽은 해당 무인기의 비행 계획을 미리 한국군에 공유했다는 입장이지만, 우리 군 당국은 이를 승인한 적 없다는 입장인 것으로 알려졌다. 한미 군 당국 간 정보공유에 빈틈이 있는 것 아니냐는 관측도 나온다.)

Military authorities plan to verify whether the US failed to notify South Korean forces about the training, whether the notification was not shared internally within the South Korean military, or whether the US Marine Corps drone deviated from its planned flight path. (군 당국은 미국이 훈련 정보를 한국군에 알리지 않았는지, 통보가 됐는데 한국군 내부에서 공유되지 않았는지, 미 해병대 무인기가 계획했던 비행경로를 벗어났는지 등을 확인할 예정이다.)

Meanwhile, in the afternoon, village heads near the Civilian Control Line in Cheorwon, Gangwon Province, received a text message titled "Informing You of the Actual Situation," stating, "A drone has been identified in the Cheorwon area, so people in the northern civilian zone must urgently move to nearby shelters or outside control points." The message was reportedly sent by an army unit in Cheorwon. The Joint Chiefs stated regarding the text message dispatch, "We will verify and provide additional explanations." (한편, 이날 오후 강원도 철원 민간인출입통제선(민통선) 근처 마을 이장들에게 ‘실제 상황 알려드립니다’라는 제목으로 “철원 지역에 무인기가 식별돼 민북 지역 내 있는 사람들은 긴급히 인근 대피호 또는 통제소 밖으로 이동해야 한다”는 내용의 문자가 발송됐다. 해당 문자는 철원의 한 육군 부대가 보낸 것으로 알려졌다. 합참은 문자 발송 경위에 대해 “다시 확인한 뒤 추가로 설명하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

By Kwon Hyuk-chul nura@hani.co.kr (권혁철 기자 nura@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "Is 'Senior Jeong' in the text really Jeong Jin-seok?" Chung Mong-gyu says "It's privacy" (“문자 속 ‘정 선배’ 정진석 맞냐”추궁에 정몽규 “프라이버시”)
item.description:
On the 30th, People Power Party lawmaker Yoon Yong-geun, who attended the National Assembly's Culture, Sports and Tourism Committee hearing on the Korea Football Association as a witness, was captured by media cameras sending an apology text message to former Korea Football Association President Chung Mong-gyu, reading: "I got a call from Senior Jeong yesterday. I should have been more considerate... I'm sorry," sparking controversy. At the hearing that day, when Democratic Party lawmaker Noh Jong-myeon pressed, "Is 'Senior Jeong' in the text the former (Yoon Suk Yeol's) chief of staff, Jeong Jin-seok?" former President Chung replied, "It's a matter of privacy, so I won't disclose that." <<> According to a photo taken by Seoul Newspaper that day, Yoon, a member of the Culture, Sports and Tourism Committee, sent a text message to former President Chung in the afternoon: "Chairman, this is Yoon Yong-geun of the People Power Party. I got a call from Senior Jeong yesterday. I should have been more considerate... I'm sorry." Chung replied, "Thank you for your concern. I will greet you in a different setting, not such a place. From Chung Mong-gyu." That day, the committee held a hearing to scrutinize overall operational issues of the Korea Football Association, which emerged after the national soccer team failed to advance past the round of 16 in the 2026 FIFA World Cup in North and Central America, summoning former coach Hong Myung-bo and former President Chung as witnesses. <<> Later at the hearing, Democratic Party lawmaker Noh Jong-myeon asked, "Since this is an issue raising suspicions of obstructing the hearing's activities, our office confirmed it. Is 'Senior Jeong' (in the text message) the former presidential chief of staff, Jeong Jin-seok?" Former President Chung replied, "It's a matter related to privacy, so I won't answer that." Noh asked again, "Is it not? Or can't you say if it's not?" and Chung responded, "I cannot say." Former Chief of Staff Jeong and former President Chung are alumni of Korea University. Noh remarked, "This is why talk of a Korea University cartel comes up." <<> Earlier, when the exchange of texts was revealed, Culture, Sports and Tourism Committee Chairman Lee Jae-jung pressed former President Chung, "In the process of preparing for the hearing, did you contact any hearing committee members for lobbying?" Former President Chung explained, "I asked what questions might come up and whether there was anything I should prepare in advance," adding it was "to answer well." He apologized, saying, "If it became a problem, I am very sorry." <<> Lawmaker Yoon explained, "Looking at the timing, after finishing the morning questioning and before coming to the hearing hall in the afternoon, I sent a text saying I was sorry for not being considerate despite having a personal acquaintance," adding, "All the committee members here know that when I came in the afternoon, I asked him quite tough questions." He added, "There was absolutely nothing exchanged (in terms of favors), and I don't think there was any problem with the hearing or that it was inadequate because of this." <<> Then Chairman Lee asked, "What's revealed by the text is that you tried to contact a committee member through 'Senior Jeong,'" and "Who is this 'Senior Jeong' that they would use networks among lawmakers to neutralize the hearing?" Former President Chung replied, "Is there an obligation to say? I'm not sure if I should say something related to privacy," adding, "They're currently not working." <<> Reporter Go Gyeong-ju goh@hani.co.kr Reporter Jo Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr (윤용근 국민의힘 의원이 30일 국회 문화체육관광위원회의 대한축구협회 청문회 증인으로 출석한 정몽규 전 대한축구협회장에게 “어제 정 선배님한테 연락받았습니다. 더 잘 배려해 드려야 하는데…송구합니다”라는 사과 메시지를 보낸 모습이 언론 카메라에 포착돼 논란이 일고 있다. 이날 청문회에서 노종면 더불어민주당 의원이 “문자 속 정 선배가 정진석 전 (윤석열 전 대통령)비서실장 맞냐”고 추궁하자 정 전 회장은 “프라이버시와 관련된 문제라 말씀드리지 않겠다”라고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee Strengthens 'Mineral Alliance' with Chile… Launches Ministerial-Level Consultative Body (이 대통령, 칠레와 ‘광물동맹' 강화…장관급 협의체 띄웠다)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung, on an official visit to Chile, signed five memoranda of understanding, including one upgrading the mineral resources consultative body to a 'ministerial level,' during a summit with President Jose Antonio Kast on the 30th (local time). (칠레를 공식 방문 중인 이재명 대통령이 30일(현지시각) 호세 안토니오 카스트 대통령과 정상회담을 계기로 광물자원 협의체를 ‘장관급’으로 격상하는 양해각서 등 5건을 체결했다.)

Following the summit held at the presidential palace in Chile, President Lee presided over the signing ceremony for the memoranda of understanding (MOUs) and a joint press conference. The signed 'Memorandum of Understanding on Mineral Resources Partnership' includes provisions for: △ Upgrading the joint committee on mineral resources partnership to the ministerial level, △ Establishing a director-level working channel, △ Cooperating across the entire lifecycle of key minerals such as lithium and copper, and △ Promoting technical cooperation and personnel exchanges. The aim is to regularize and elevate the consultative body between Chile, which holds the world's largest reserves of lithium and copper, and the South Korean government to a ministerial level, thereby enhancing the stability of mineral supply and demand worth $2.1 billion annually from Chile, while building an institutional foundation to support local expansion by South Korean companies. <<> Additionally, a 'Memorandum of Understanding on Investment Cooperation' was signed to promote bilateral investment between South Korea and Chile and facilitate the exchange of investment information. Other agreements included a 'Memorandum of Understanding on Security Cooperation' to establish a global security network for joint responses to transnational crimes, a 'Memorandum of Understanding on Maritime Safety and Security Cooperation' to strengthen maritime law enforcement against transnational crimes and illegal fishing, and an 'Amendment to the Memorandum of Understanding on Polar Research Cooperation' aimed at enhancing collaboration with Chile, a gateway country for accessing the King Sejong Antarctic Science Station. <<> Santiago/Seo Young-ji reporter yj@hani.co.kr ( 이 대통령은 이날 칠레 대통령궁에서 열린 정상회담 뒤 ‘양해각서’(MOU) 서명식과 공동언론발표를 진행했다. 먼저 양국이 체결한 ‘광물자원 파트너십 양해각서’에는 △광물자원 파트너십 공동위원회를 장관급으로 격상하고 △국장급 실무채널 신설 △리튬·구리 등 주요 광물 전주기 협력 △기술협력 및 인적교류 추진 등이 담겼다. 리튬·구리 매장량 세계 1위인 칠레와 우리 정부 간 협의체를 장관급으로 격상·정례화해 연 21억불 규모의 대칠레 광물 수급 안정성을 제고하고, 우리 기업들의 현지 진출을 지원하는 제도적 기반을 구축하겠다는 것이다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Expand Korea-Chile Trade and Investment Further"... FTA Improvement Talks Resume (이 대통령 “한·칠레 교역·투자 더 확대”… FTA 개선 협의 재가동)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung, on an official visit to Chile, stated on the 30th (local time) that during a summit with President José Antonio Kast, who took office in March this year, "The two countries have agreed to further expand trade and investment cooperation for mutual growth." (칠레를 공식 방문 중인 이재명 대통령이 30일(현지시각) 올해 3월 취임한 호세 안토니오 카스트 대통령과 정상회담을 계기로 “양국은 동반성장을 위해 교역·투자 협력을 더욱 확대해 나가기로 했다”고 밝혔다.)

In a joint press conference after the summit held at the Chilean presidential palace, President Lee said, "Since the signing of the Free Trade Agreement, bilateral trade volume has quadrupled in 20 years, proving that the strategic choices of both countries were correct." He added, "The two countries have decided to restart the Korea-Chile Free Trade Agreement (FTA) Free Trade Committee after 10 years to review trade and investment issues, and to consult on ways to enhance bilateral trade relations, including improvements to the mutually beneficial Korea-Chile FTA." ( 이 대통령은 이날 칠레 대통령궁에서 열린 정상회담 뒤 공동언론발표에서 “자유무역협정 체결 이후 양국 교역액은 20년 만에 4배로 증가해 양국의 전략적 선택이 옳았음을 입증했다”며 “양국은 한-칠레 자유무역협정(FTA) 자유무역위원회를 10년 만에 재가동해 통상·투자 현안을 점검하고, 호혜적인 한-칠레 자유무역협정 개선 등을 포함한 양국 통상 관계 증진 방안에 대해 협의해 나가기로 했다”고 말했다.)

The Korea-Chile FTA, which took effect in 2004, is Korea's first free trade agreement. The two countries have been conducting improvement negotiations since 2018 to deepen trade and investment, and to reflect modernized trade norms in the agreement, including supply chains, energy and raw materials, the digital economy, intellectual property rights, and the environment. ( 2004년 발효된 한-칠레 자유무역협정은 우리나라 최초의 자유무역협정이다. 양국은 교역·투자 등을 심화하고, 공급망, 에너지·원자재, 디지털 경제, 지식재산권, 환경 등 현대화된 통상 규범을 협정문에 반영하기 위해 2018년부터 개선 협상을 진행하고 있다.)

Additionally, President Lee stated, "The two countries have agreed to actively pursue mutually beneficial and future-oriented cooperation in strategic areas such as critical mineral supply chains, infrastructure, security, and defense," and noted, "Chile, the world's largest copper producer and holder of the largest lithium reserves, and Korea, a leader in advanced industries like semiconductors and batteries, are natural and ideal partners in building critical mineral supply chains." ( 아울러 이 대통령은 “양국은 핵심광물 공급망, 인프라, 치안, 방산 등 전략적인 분야에서 호혜적이고 미래지향적인 협력을 적극 추진해 나가기로 했다”며 “세계 1위 구리 생산국이자 1위 리튬 매장국인 주요 자원 부국 칠레와 반도체·배터리 등 첨단산업 선도국인 한국은 핵심광물 공급망 구축에 있어 자연스럽고 이상적인 파트너”라고 말했다.)

President Lee added, "Based on the 'Memorandum of Understanding on Mineral Resource Partnership,' the two countries have agreed to expand cooperation to the entire mineral resource supply chain and to enhance specific cooperation in areas such as information exchange, technology collaboration, and personnel exchanges." The MOU includes provisions to upgrade the Mineral Resource Partnership Joint Committee to the ministerial level and to establish a working-level channel at the director-general level. ( 이 대통령은 그러면서 “양국은 ‘광물자원 파트너십 양해각서’를 바탕으로 협력의 범위를 광물자원 공급망 전반으로 확대하고, 정보 교환, 기술협력, 인적 교류 등의 구체적인 협력을 확대해 나가기로 했다”고 덧붙였다. 양해각서에는 광물자원 파트너십 공동위원회를 장관급으로 격상하고, 국장급 실무채널을 신설하는 내용 등이 담겼다.)

President Lee also emphasized, "We agreed on the importance of establishing an institutional foundation to deepen cooperation in the defense and shipbuilding sectors, and decided to continue related discussions." ( 이 대통령은 또 “방산과 조선 분야의 협력을 심화하기 위해 제도적인 기반을 마련하는 게 중요하다는 데 공감하고 관련 논의를 이어 나가기로 했다”고 강조했다.)

The two countries also agreed to expand scientific and technological cooperation, as well as personnel and cultural exchanges. President Lee said, "The two countries have jointly explored 'Antarctica,' a common heritage of humanity," and added, "I take this opportunity to express gratitude to Chile for its active support of South Korea's Antarctic base activities. We look forward to continued cooperation from Chile so that our personnel can safely conduct their research." ( 양국은 과학기술 협력과 인적·문화적 교류도 확대해 나가기로 했다. 이 대통령은 “양국은 인류 공동의 유산인 ‘남극’을 함께 탐구해 왔다”며 “이 자리를 빌려 대한민국의 남극 기지 활동을 적극적으로 지원해 온 칠레 측에 감사드린다. 앞으로도 우리 대원들이 안전하게 연구에 임할 수 있도록 칠레 측의 지속적인 협력을 기대한다”고 말했다.)

They also agreed to cooperate closely for peace, stability, and prosperity on the Korean Peninsula and in the international community. President Lee stated, "In today's meeting, I requested Chile's unwavering support in resolving the North Korean nuclear issue and establishing peace on the Korean Peninsula," and noted, "President Kast expressed his willingness to work together for peace and stability on the Korean Peninsula." item.title: President Lee presents 'Najeonchilgi Ilwolobongdo' to Chilean President (이 대통령, 칠레 대통령에 ‘나전칠기 일월오봉도’ 선물)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung, on an official visit to Chile, presented Chilean President Jose Antonio Kast with a Najeonchilgi (mother-of-pearl lacquerware) Ilwolobongdo (Sun, Moon, and Five Peaks) and a brass wine glass set on the 30th (local time). (칠레를 공식 방문 중인 이재명 대통령이 30일(현지시각) 호세 안토니오 카스트 칠레 대통령에게 나전칠기 일월오봉도와 유기 와인잔 세트 등을 선물했다.)

The Najeonchilgi Ilwolobongdo is a piece that expresses the Ilwolobongdo, which adorned the backdrop of the king's throne during the Joseon Dynasty, using traditional mother-of-pearl lacquer techniques. The presidential office explained, "It was selected with the hope that President Kast, who took office in March, will lead the nation with wise leadership and achieve prosperity for Chile." The brass wine glass set was chosen considering that Chile is a world-renowned wine region. ( 나전칠기 일월오봉도는 조선시대 임금의 어좌 뒤를 장식하던 일월오봉도를 전통 나전 기법으로 표현한 작품이다. 청와대는 "지난 3월 취임한 카스트 대통령이 현명한 리더십으로 새롭게 국정을 이끌어 칠레의 번영을 이루기를 기원하는 의미로 선정했다"고 설명했다. 또 유기 와인잔 세트는 칠레가 세계적인 와인 산지인 점을 고려해 선정했다.)

For First Lady María Pía Adriasola, a white porcelain Western-style tableware set and a premium K-beauty package were gifted. ( 마리아 피아 아드리아솔라 여사를 위해서는 백자 서양 식기 세트와 프리미엄 케이(K)-뷰티 패키지를 선물했다.)

The Chilean side gifted President Lee and his wife an alpaca blanket, a coffee drip set, a jewelry box made of lapis lazuli, and Chilean wine. ( 칠레 측은 이 대통령 부부를 위해 알파카 담요, 커피 드립 세트, 청금석으로 제작한 보석함, 칠레산 와인 등을 선물했다.)

item.title: President Lee Makes Surprise Visit to Chile’s ‘Korea Street’… Confirms K-Beauty Popularity (이 대통령, 칠레 ‘한국의 거리' 깜짝 방문… K-뷰티 인기 확인)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung, who is on an official visit to Chile, visited Santiago’s ‘Korea Street’ on the 30th (local time) alongside First Lady Kim Hye-kyung, engaging with citizens. (칠레를 공식 방문 중인 이재명 대통령이 30일(현지시각) 김혜경 여사와 산티아고의 ‘한국의 거리’를 방문해 시민들과 소통했다.)

President Lee visited the Korean Association of Chile located on Korea Street, where he received briefings from the association’s president, Ha Sang-wook, on the association’s activities, its private security system, and spaces used as overseas polling stations, as announced by Cheong Wa Dae Deputy Spokesperson Ahn Gwi-ryeong in a written briefing. (이 대통령은 이날 한국의 거리에 위치한 칠레한인회를 방문해 하상욱 칠레한인회장으로부터 한인회의 활동 현황과 자체 방범 체계, 재외투표소로 활용되는 공간 등에 대한 설명을 들었다고 안귀령 청와대 부대변인이 서면 브리핑을 통해 밝혔다.)

Korea Street is approximately 600 meters long in the Patronato area of downtown Santiago, where the Korean Association building and Korean-owned shops are concentrated. The Korea Street project, driven by the Korean Association of Chile, came to fruition after undergoing procedures including approval from the district office and council, and gained further momentum with President Lee’s visit to Chile, strengthening the designation of ‘Korea Street.’ (한국의 거리는 산티아고 시내 한인회관과 한인 상가들이 모여 있는 파트로나토 지역의 약 600m 거리다. 한국의 거리 사업은 칠레한인회가 추진해온 사업으로 구청과 구의회의 승인 등 관련 절차를 거쳐 결실을 맺었고, 이 대통령의 칠레 방문을 계기로 '한국의 거리' 지정에 더욱 힘이 실렸다.)

Korean residents and locals holding Taegeukgi greeted President Lee, shouting “Welcome” and “We welcome you.” One Korean resident conveyed their emotions by singing the national anthem. (태극기를 손에 든 동포들과 주민들은 이 대통령을 보자 “어서 오세요” “환영합니다”라고 외치며 인사했다. 한 동포는 애국가를 부르며 벅찬 마음을 전하기도 했다.)

The presidential couple visited a snack bar and a meat restaurant run by Koreans, encouraging the proprietors. They also asked citizens dining there, “Is the Korean food delicious?” They also stopped by a pharmacy to examine displayed Korean cosmetics, inquiring about the local popularity of K-beauty. The pharmacy staff replied, “The number of consumers seeking Korean cosmetics is steadily increasing.” (이 대통령 부부는 한인들이 운영하는 분식집과 고깃집 등을 찾아 상인들을 격려했다. 이 대통령 부부는 식사를 하던 시민들에게 “한국 음식 맛있어요?”라고 직접 묻기도 했다. 또 약국을 찾아 진열된 한국 화장품을 살펴보며 현지에서의 케이(K)-뷰티 인기에 대해 물었다. 약국 관계자는 “한국 화장품을 찾는 소비자가 꾸준히 늘고 있다”고 말했다.)

Deputy Spokesperson Ahn stated, “Following the creation of ‘Seoul Street’ nearby in 2022, the addition of ‘Korea Street’ has turned this area into a symbolic space showcasing the friendly exchanges between Korea and Chile, as well as the legacy of the Chilean Korean community. The Korean Association of Chile plans to further develop it into a hub for promoting Korean culture by creating a Korean-themed street linking the two streets through environmental improvement projects.” (안 부대변인은 “지난 2022년 인근에 조성된 ‘서울의 거리’에 이어 ‘한국의 거리’가 더해지면서 이 일대는 한국과 칠레의 우호와 교류, 칠레 동포사회의 발자취를 보여주는 상징적인 공간으로 자리매김하게 됐다”며 “칠레한인회는 앞으로 환경 개선 사업 등을 통해 두 거리를 연계한 한국 테마 거리를 조성해 한국 문화를 널리 알리는 거점으로 발전시켜나갈 계획”이라고 말했다.)

Santiago/Correspondent Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (산티아고/서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)
