item.title: DP to Hold Public Briefing on Criminal Procedure Act on the 3rd…“Will Fully Explain Public Questions” (민주, 3일 형소법 대국민보고회 연다…“국민 궁금증 충분히 설명할 것”)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea has decided to establish an internal body to prepare measures to strengthen the rights of crime victims among socially vulnerable groups as soon as the Criminal Procedure Act, which completely abolishes prosecutors’ supplementary investigation rights, is processed. It also decided to hold a public briefing on the Criminal Procedure Act on the 3rd of next month. (더불어민주당은 ‘검사 보완수사권 완전 폐지’ 형사소송법 처리되는 대로 사회적 약자 대상 범죄 피해자 권익 강화 방안을 마련하기 위해 당내 기구를 설치하기로 했다. 또, 내달 3일 형사소송법 대국민 보고회를 개최하기로 했다.)

Han Byung-do, acting leader and floor leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, said at a supreme council meeting on the 31st, “Today’s revision of the Criminal Procedure Act is not the end of prosecution reform but the beginning of a new criminal justice system. In the process of launching the new system, there must be no gaps in protecting the rights of the people or any vacuum in investigations.” (한병도 더불어민주당 대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표는 31일 최고위원회의에서 “오늘의 형사소송법 개정은 검찰개혁의 끝이 아닌 새로운 형사사법 체계의 시작이다. 새로운 제도 출범 과정에서 국민의 권리 보호에 빈틈이 생기거나 수사 공백이 발생하는 일이 없어야 한다”며 이같이 밝혔다.)

The revision bill to the Criminal Procedure Act, centered on the complete abolition of prosecutors’ supplementary investigation rights, was tabled at the National Assembly plenary session the previous day, and is expected to pass by vote once the unlimited debate (filibuster) concludes in the afternoon. Floor Leader Han said, “The Democratic Party will fully explain the public’s questions and carefully review any concerns raised,” adding, “We will thoroughly manage follow-up statutes and institutional arrangements and take full responsibility to ensure the Serious Crimes Investigation Office and the Public Prosecution Service are launched stably on October 2.” (검찰의 보완수사권 완전 폐지를 뼈대로 한 형사소송법 개정안은 전날 국회 본회의에 상정됐고, 이날 오후 무제한 토론(필리버스터)이 종료되면 표결에 부쳐져 통과될 전망이다. 한 원내대표는 “민주당은 국민 여러분의 궁금증을 충분히 설명하고 제기되는 우려도 꼼꼼히 살필 것”이라며 “후속 법령과 제도 정비까지 빈틈없이 챙겨 10월2일 중대범죄수사청과 공소청이 안정적으로 출범할 수 있도록 끝까지 책임을 다하겠다”라고 했다.)

item.title: People Power Party's Chung Jeom-sik: "Abolishing Prosecutors' Supplementary Investigation Rights Is the End of the Rule of Law" (국힘 정점식 “검사 보완수사권 폐지는 법치주의의 종말”)
item.description:
The People Power Party on the 31st pushed back against the revision to the Criminal Procedure Act, which would completely abolish prosecutors' supplementary investigation rights and is scheduled to be processed at the National Assembly plenary session, calling it "the end of the rule of law." (국민의힘이 31일 국회 본회의에서 처리될 예정인 ‘검사 보완수사권 완전 폐지’ 형사소송법 개정안을 “법치주의의 종말”이라고 반발했다.)

Chung Jeom-sik, the People Power Party's floor leader, made these remarks at a floor strategy meeting held at the National Assembly that day, saying, "If the supplementary investigation rights disappear, ordinary citizens will suffer from poor and delayed investigations, and those without money or power will suffer even more." (정점식 국민의힘 원내대표는 이날 국회에서 원내대책회의를 열고 “보완수사권이 사라지면 평범한 국민은 부실 수사, 늑장 수사 등으로 고통받고, 돈 없고 힘 없으면 더욱 더 고통받을 것”이라며 이같이 말했다.)

Floor leader Chung said, "Furthermore, the Democratic Party secretly inserted a provision that relaxes the court's dismissal of indictment, allowing for the deletion of a trial against the president. They have committed a shameless deception, akin to palming cards in a rigged gambling game, in the National Assembly, which should uphold the law." He added, "Is the 'working National Assembly' the Democratic Party talks about nothing more than a body that paves an escape route to delete Lee Jae-myung's presidential trial?" He then warned, "If this bad law passes, many side effects will soon emerge, and when that time comes, the massive anger of the public will judge the Democratic Party." (정 원내대표는 “민주당은 게다가 대통령에 대한 재판을 삭제할 수 있는 법원의 공소기각 완화 조항을 몰래 끼워넣었다. 법을 수호해야 할 국회에서 사기도박의 밑장빼기와 같은 파렴치한 속임수를 자행한 것”이라며 “민주당이 말하는 ‘일하는 국회’가 고작 이재명 대통령의 재판 삭제를 위해 도피로를 깔아주는 일을 하는 국회라는 것인가”라고 말했다. 이어 그는 “이 악법이 통과되면 머지않아 많은 부작용이 생길 것이고, 그때가 되면 거대한 민심의 분노가 민주당을 심판할 것”이라고 경고했다.)

The revision to the Criminal Procedure Act, currently under unlimited debate (filibuster) in the National Assembly, is expected to be processed at the plenary session after a vote to close debate around 4:07 p.m. that day. Following that, a revision to the National Assembly Act, which shortens the review period for bills designated as fast-track from up to 330 days to 90 days, is set to be introduced. (현재 국회에서 무제한 토론(필리버스터)이 진행 중인 형사소송법 개정안은 이날 오후 4시7분께 토론 종결 표결을 거쳐 본회의에서 처리될 전망이다. 이어 패스트트랙으로 지정된 법안의 심사기간을 최장 330일에서 90일로 단축하는 내용의 국회법 개정안이 상정될 예정이다.)

Floor leader Chung also said of the National Assembly Act revision, "It is a dictatorial bad law that treats the National Assembly as the Democratic Party's rubber stamp and aims to turn it into a machine that raises its hand even faster in the future." He added, "The Democratic Party should learn a lesson from hastily introducing single-stock leveraged ETFs without sufficient review or deliberation, which caused great chaos in the stock market." The People Power Party has also signaled a filibuster against the National Assembly Act revision, so the bill is expected to be put to a vote at the first plenary session of the August extraordinary session. (정 원내대표는 국회법 개정안에 대해서도 “국회를 민주당의 거수기로 여기고 앞으로 더 빨리 손드는 기계로 만들겠다는 독재 악법”이라고 말했다. 이어 “민주당은 단일종목 레버리지 ETF를 충분한 검토와 숙의 없이 졸속 도입했다가 주식시장에 대혼란을 초래한 것에서 교훈을 얻어야 한다”고 덧붙였다. 국민의힘은 국회법 개정안에 대해서도 필리버스터를 예고해, 개정안은 8월 임시국회 첫 본회의에서 표결에 부쳐질 전망이다.)

Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (유영재 기자 young@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democratic Party leadership "Taking leverage risks seriously... to swiftly establish investor protection body" (민주 수뇌부 “레버리지 엄중 인식…투자자 보호기구 조속 구성 ”)
item.description:
Han Byung-do, acting leader and floor leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, said on the 31st, "We are taking the current market situation and investors' concerns very seriously," adding, "We will calmly and transparently review whether the process of introducing single-stock leveraged exchange-traded funds (ETFs) and investor protection measures were sufficient." The domestic stock market has seen repeated sharp fluctuations, centered on major semiconductor stocks such as SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics, with volatility increasing. (한병도 더불어민주당 대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표는 31일 “현재의 시장 상황과 투자자 여러분의 우려를 엄중하게 인식하고 있다”며 “단일 종목 레버리지 상장지수펀드(ETF) 상품 도입 과정과 투자자 보호 장치가 충분했는지 차분하고 투명하게 점검하겠다”고 밝혔다. 국내 증시는 에스케이(SK)하이닉스와 삼성전자 등 대형 반도체주를 중심으로 연일 급등락을 반복하며 변동성이 커진 상황이다.)

Floor leader Han said, "We need to comprehensively examine complex factors, including the sharp rises and falls in global semiconductor stocks and the supply-demand structure concentrated on specific stocks, and find proper solutions," adding, "The Democratic Party will closely communicate with financial authorities and the industry, centering on the K-Capital Market Special Committee, and carefully monitor the effectiveness of implemented measures and market reactions." (한 원내대표는 “글로벌 반도체주의 급등락과 특정 종목에 집중된 수급 구조 등 복합적인 요인을 총체적으로 점검하고, 제대로 된 해법을 찾아야 한다”며 “민주당은 케이(K)-자본시장 특별위원회를 중심으로 금융당국 및 업계와 긴밀히 소통하며 시행되는 조치의 효과와 시장 반응을 세심하게 살피겠다”고 말했다.)

Supreme Council member Kang Deuk-gu proposed "swiftly establishing a special body to complement the leverage system and protect investors, together with the party's policy committee, government financial authorities, and private market experts." Supreme Council member Park Kyu-hwan said, "In particular, the asset base of ordinary people and young people is being shaken," adding, "We will take special measures, including a temporary suspension of trading in leveraged products, to ensure structural stability in the stock market and protect individual investors." (강득구 최고위원은 “당 정책위와 정부 금융당국, 민간시장 전문가들과 함께 레버리지 제도 보완과 투자자 보호를 위한 특별기구를 조속히 구성할 것”을 제안했다. 박규환 최고위원은 “특히 서민과 청년들의 자산 기반이 흔들리고 있다”며 “레버리지 상품의 일시적 거래 중단을 포함해 주식시장의 구조적 안정과 개인 투자자를 지키기 위한 특단의 대책을 세우도록 하겠다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr (정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr)

item.title: People Power Party Ethics Committee "Dismiss Members Who Leak Internal Discussions"... Within Party, "Cannot Silence Criticism" (국힘 윤리위 “내부 논의 유출자 해임”…당내선 “비판 입막음 안 돼”)
item.description:
Criticism is emerging within the People Power Party that the Central Ethics Committee's warning about the possible dismissal of members who leak internal discussions amounts to "muzzling" dissent. (국민의힘 중앙윤리위원회가 내부 논의를 유출한 윤리위원에 대해 해임 가능성을 경고한 것을 두고, 당내에서 “입막음”이라는 비판이 나오고 있다.)

Supreme Council member Yang Hyang-ja appeared on KBS Radio's "Emergency Current Affairs" on the 31st and said, "Confidentiality is a shield that protects the Ethics Committee," adding, "It should not become a tool to block criticism." She further stated, "Before the committee chair issues a strong warning about requesting dismissal, he should have first clearly defined the scope of the confidentiality obligation and what actions constitute a violation." (양향자 최고위원은 31일 한국방송(KBS) 라디오 ‘전격시사’에 출연해 “비밀 유지는 윤리위를 보호하는 방패”라며 “비판을 막는 입막음 수단이 돼서는 안 된다”고 말했다. 그러면서 “윤리위원장이 해임 요청이라는 강한 경고를 하기 전에 비밀 유지 의무의 범위가 어디까지인지, 어떤 행위가 위반에 해당하는지부터 명확하게 밝혔어야 한다”고 말했다.)

Woo Jae-joon, the People Power Party's youth supreme council member, appeared on YTN Radio's "Jang Seong-cheol's News Myeongdang" the same day and said, "(Ethics Committee Chair Yoon Min-woo's remarks) are as if saying we should not say anything at all," adding, "There clearly seem to be problems within the (Ethics Committee) right now, and (because of this), biased outcomes appear to be resulting." (우재준 국민의힘 청년최고위원은 이날 와이티엔(YTN) 라디오 ‘장성철의 뉴스명당’에 출연해 “(윤민우 윤리위원장의 말은) 마치 아무런 말을 하지 말라는 것”이라며 “지금 (윤리위 내) 문제가 뻔히 있어 보이는데, (이 때문에) 결과적으로도 편향적인 결과들이 나오는 것 같다”고 했다.)

Previously, Chair Yoon Min-woo stated in a position statement the day before, "If violations of the confidentiality obligation regarding internal discussions of the Central Ethics Committee recur in the future, I will take strict measures, including requesting the party leader to dismiss the relevant committee member in accordance with relevant regulations." This is interpreted as a response to Vice Chair Woo Jong-hwan and others publicly raising issues about Yoon's unilateral management of committee meetings. The party's internal rules, the "Ethics Committee Regulations," stipulate "duties of fairness and confidentiality." (앞서 윤민우 위원장이 전날 입장문에서 “앞으로 중앙윤리위원회 내부의 논의와 관련된 비밀유지 의무 위반이 재발할 경우, 관련 규정에 따라 해당 윤리위원의 해임을 당대표에게 요청하는 등 엄정하게 조치하겠다”고 밝혔다. 우종환 윤리위 부위원장 등은 윤 위원장의 일방적인 회의 운영에 대해 공개적으로 문제를 제기하자, 이를 문제 삼은 것으로 풀이된다. 국민의힘 당규 ‘윤리위원회 규정’에는 ‘공정 및 비밀유지 의무’가 명시되어 있다.)

Supreme Council member Woo countered Yoon's statement on the radio, saying, "It's no secret that (the party's Ethics Committee) is being run arbitrarily," and "Disclosing facts about a person under disciplinary review that were learned during work constitutes a leak of secrets." (우 최고위원은 라디오에서 “(당 윤리위가) 독단적으로 운영되고 있다는 건 비밀이 아니”라며 “업무 도중 알게 된 피징계자에 대한 사실관계를 외부로 알리는 게 비밀 누설”이라고 윤 위원장의 입장문을 반박했다.)

Meanwhile, the People Power Party clashed at its Supreme Council meeting the day before over an agenda item to appoint two additional members to the party's Central Ethics Committee. During this process, Supreme Council member Woo expressed opposition, arguing that an investigation into Yoon's unilateral management of meetings and bias should take precedence, while Supreme Council member Yang abstained, saying further review was needed. (한편, 국민의힘은 전날 열린 최고위원회의에서 당 중앙윤리위원 2명을 추가 임명하는 안건을 놓고 충돌을 빚었다. 이 과정에서 우 최고위원은 윤 위원장의 독단적인 회의 운영과 편향성에 대한 조사부터 선행돼야 한다며 반대 의사를 밝혔고, 양 최고위원은 추가 검토가 필요하다며 기권했다.)

As a result of the vote, the two additional Central Ethics Committee members were appointed with a majority in favor, increasing the number of committee members from five to seven. Previously, after two Central Ethics Committee members resigned in succession, a meeting attended by only three of the five members voted to initiate disciplinary proceedings against lawmakers Kwon Young-jin, Cho Kyeong-tae, and Jin Jong-oh, which had already raised questions of fairness. (표결 결과 과반의 찬성으로 중앙윤리위원 2명이 추가 임명되면서 윤리위원은 기존 5명에서 7명으로 늘어났다. 앞서 중앙윤리위원 2명이 잇달아 사임한 데 이어, 윤리위원 5명 중 3명만 참석한 회의에서 권영진·조경태·진종오 의원에 대한 징계 개시가 의결되면서 공정성 논란이 제기된 바 있다.)

Kim Hae-jung Reporter sea@hani.co.kr (김해정 기자 sea@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Park Ji-won: "Prosecutors Stripped of Investigative Powers Should Blame Yoon Suk-yeol and Han Dong-hoon" (박지원 “수사권 박탈된 검사들, 윤석열·한동훈을 원망하라”)
item.description:
With the Criminal Procedure Act amendment abolishing prosecutors' supplementary investigative powers being brought to the National Assembly plenary session on the 30th, Democratic Party lawmaker Park Ji-won said, "If some prosecutors want to resent having their investigative powers taken away, they should blame Yoon Suk-yeol and Han Dong-hoon." (검사의 보완수사권을 폐지하는 형사소송법 개정안이 30일 국회 본회의에 상정된 가운데, 박지원 더불어민주당 의원이 “일부 검사들이 수사권 박탈된 걸 원망을 (하려거든) 윤석열과 한동훈한테 하라”고 말했다.)

Park, a member of the National Assembly Legislation and Judiciary Committee, appeared on Gwangju Broadcasting Corporation (KBC)'s "Yeouido Invitation" that day and said, "Since liberation, how much have prosecutors acted as handmaidens to dictators and military autocrats, killing and fabricating cases against innocent citizens?" adding, "Recently, especially because Yoon Suk-yeol and Han Dong-hoon lit the fire, the prosecution has been completely reformed." Park added, "I celebrate the success of President Lee Jae-myung's prosecution reform." (국회 법제사법위원회 소속 박 의원은 이날 광주방송(KBC) ‘여의도 초대석’에 출연해 “해방 후 지금까지 검찰이 얼마나 독재자, 군사 독재자들의 시녀로서 무고한 국민을 죽이고 조작했나”라며 “최근에 특히 윤석열, 한동훈이 불을 지르니까 완전히 (검찰이) 개혁된 것”이라며 이같이 말했다. 박 의원은 “이재명 대통령의 검찰 개혁 성공을 자축한다“고 덧붙였다.)

Regarding Acting Prosecutor General Gu Ja-hyun (Deputy Prosecutor General of the Supreme Prosecutors' Office) issuing a statement on the 29th publicly opposing the Criminal Procedure Act amendment, saying "South Korea's criminal justice system will collapse," Park said, "Even with a thousand mouths, they have no right to speak." Park also said, "If the prosecution is the one that didn't even investigate Kim Keon-hee, returned her phone, and coordinated in advance, isn't that exactly what deserves reform?" This appears to reference the controversy over the so-called "imperial investigation" by the Seoul Central District Prosecutors' Office team that investigated First Lady Kim Keon-hee's Deutsche Motors stock manipulation and luxury bag acceptance cases during the Yoon Suk-yeol administration. (구자현 검찰총장 직무대행(대검 차장)이 29일 입장문을 내어 형사소송법 개정안에 대해 “대한민국의 형사사법 체계가 무너질 것”이라며 공개적으로 반대 입장을 밝힌 데 대해선 “입이 천 개가 있어도 말을 할 자격이 없다”고 말했다. 박 의원은 “김건희를 수사도 안 하고 핸드폰 반납하고 사전에 조율해서 하는 그런 짓을 하는 게 대한민국 검찰이었다고 하면 이것은 개혁의 대상 아니냐”고도 했다. 윤석열 정부 시절 김건희 여사의 도이치모터스 주가조작과 명품백 수수 사건을 수사했던 서울중앙지검 수사팀의 이른바 ‘황제 조사’ 논란을 언급한 것으로 보인다.)

Park identified former President Yoon Suk-yeol and independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon as "the very people who brought about today's prosecution reform." He said, "Yoon Suk-yeol and Han Dong-hoon are people who have nothing to say even with a thousand mouths," adding, "That's why I say in reverse: if some prosecutors resent having their investigative powers stripped and the prosecution dismantled, direct that resentment at Yoon Suk-yeol and Han Dong-hoon." (박 의원은 “오늘날 검찰 개혁을 가져온 장본인들”로 윤석열 전 대통령과 한동훈 무소속 의원을 지목했다. 그러면서 “윤석열, 한동훈은 입이 천 개라도 할 말이 없는 사람들”이라며 “그렇기 때문에 일부 검사들이 수사권 박탈되고 검찰이 해체된 것을 원망을 (하려거든 윤석열과) 한동훈한테 하라고 역으로 말씀드린다”고 했다.)

When the host mentioned former Daegu Mayor Hong Joon-pyo's recent Facebook post stating that "the prosecution being branded as a political prosecution and pushed to the brink of losing its investigative powers is entirely due to the tyranny of Yoon Suk-yeol and Han Dong-hoon's political prosecution," Park said, "Of course. Former Mayor Hong says a lot of right things," and reiterated, "Lawmaker Han Dong-hoon is a person without the qualifications (to speak on the Criminal Procedure Act amendment)." (진행자가 “오늘날 검찰이 정치검찰로 몰려 수사권이 존폐의 기로에 몰린 것은 전적으로 윤석열·한동훈의 정치검찰 패악에서 비롯된 것”이라는 홍준표 전 대구시장의 최근 페이스북 글을 언급하자 박 의원은 “당연하다. 홍 전 시장이 옳은 말을 많이 한다”며 “한동훈 의원은 (형사소송법 개정안에 대해 말할) 자격이 없는 사람”이라고 재차 강조했다.)

Han had posted on Facebook on the 24th, when the Democratic Party confirmed the Criminal Procedure Act amendment as party policy, claiming, "The Democratic Party regime has confirmed as party policy the ban on supplementary investigations that causes enormous harm to the people. They have finally decided to side with criminals." He also described the inclusion of provisions adding grounds for dismissal of prosecution as "the Democratic Party sneaking something ugly into the Criminal Procedure Act again" (on the 29th). (한 의원은 민주당이 형사소송법 개정안을 당론으로 추인한 지난 24일 페이스북에 글을 올려 “국민에게 엄청난 피해 주는 보완수사 금지를 민주당 정권이 당론으로 확정했다. 끝내 범죄자의 편에 서기로 한 것”이라고 주장한 바 있다. 이어 형사소송법 개정안에 법원의 공소기각 사유를 추가하는 내용이 포함된 것을 두고는 “민주당이 흉한 걸 또 형사소송법에 끼워 넣었다”(29일)고 표현하기도 했다.)

item.title: Average weight of Korean 19-year-old men is 73kg... obesity rate rises from 23% to 31% over 11 years (한국 19살 남성 평균 73kg…11년 새 비만 비율 23%→31%)
item.description:
The Military Manpower Administration announced on the 31st that it has registered the "Health Indicators of Korean 19-Year-Old Men," an analysis of 2.95 million physical examination records for military service spanning 11 years from those born in 1996 to 2006, as national statistics, and will annually disclose changes in the health of young Korean men going forward. (병무청은 31일 1996년생부터 2006년생까지 11년 간의 병역판정검사 자료 295만건을 분석한 ‘한국인 19세 남성 건강지표’를 국가통계로 등록하고, 앞으로 매년 우리나라 청년 남성의 건강 변화를 공개한다고 밝혔다.)

These statistics are based on physical examination data for military service administered to all 19-year-old men and include 24 indicators that reflect youth health, such as body mass index (BMI), blood pressure, blood sugar, cholesterol, triglycerides, liver function, blood tests, and mental health. The Military Manpower Administration explained that this is significant because it allows for tracking health trends across the younger generation. (이번 통계는 19살 남성 전원을 대상으로 실시하는 병역판정검사 자료를 기반으로 구축한 것으로, 체질량지수(BMI), 혈압, 혈당, 콜레스테롤, 중성지방, 간기능, 혈액검사, 정신건강 등 청년 건강을 보여주는 24개 지표를 담고 있다. 이를 통해 청년 세대의 건강 변화 추이를 파악할 수 있다는 점에서 의미가 크다는게 병무청 설명이다.)

According to the data, the average weight of 19-year-old men increased from 69.44 kg to 73.37 kg. While the average weight of the top 10% increased by 7.8 kg over the 11-year period, the bottom 10% saw only a 0.6 kg increase, showing that weight gain among young people was relatively concentrated in the upper group. (자료를 보면, 19살 남성의 평균 체중은 69.44㎏에서 73.37㎏으로 증가했다. 상위 10%의 평균 체중은 11년간 7.8㎏ 증가한 반면, 하위 10%의 평균 체중은 0.6㎏증가에 그쳐 청년층의 체중 증가가 상위 집단에 상대적으로 집중되는 양상을 보였다.)

The obesity rate (BMI 25 or higher) rose from 23% to 31%. The obese group showed higher systolic blood pressure, total cholesterol, and triglycerides than the underweight group, indicating a tendency for risk factors for cardiovascular and metabolic diseases to increase together. (비만(BMI 25 이상) 비율은 23%에서 31%로 증가했다. 비만 그룹은 저체중 그룹보다 수축기 혈압, 총콜레스테롤, 중성지방이 모두 높게 나타나 심혈관질환과 대사질환의 위험인자가 함께 증가하는 경향을 보였다.)

The Military Manpower Administration stated, "As the only institution in the country that examines health status using the same procedures and standards to determine physical fitness grades required for fulfilling military service obligations, we hold health data for the entire male population of South Korea. We will go beyond using this vast data for physical grade assessments and utilize it as foundational material for national youth health policies." (병무청은 “병역의무 이행에 필요한 신체 등급 판정을 위해 동일한 절차와 기준으로 건강 상태를 검사하는 국내 유일 기관으로 대한민국 남성 전체의 건강 데이터를 보유하고 있다. 이런 방대한 데이터를 신체등급 판정에 그치지 않고 국가 청년 건강정책의 기초자료로 활용하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

The "Health Indicators of Korean 19-Year-Old Men" will be published regularly every year through the Korean Statistical Information Service (KOSIS) and the Public Data Portal. If raw data is requested for purposes such as research, it will be made available after de-identifying personal information through the Public Data Portal and data safe zones. item.title: People Power Party: "Yoon Yong-geun-Jung Mong-gyu Text Messages Due to Personal Friendship... Not a Matter for Apology" (국힘 “윤용근-정몽규 문자, 개인적 친분 때문…사과할 일은 아냐”)
item.description:
The ruling and opposition parties showed sharply contrasting positions over a text message sent by People Power Party lawmaker Yoon Yong-geun to former Korea Football Association President Chung Mong-gyu, who appeared as a witness at the National Assembly's Culture, Sports and Tourism Committee hearing on the Korea Football Association on the 30th, which read, "I should have taken better care of you... I'm sorry." While the Democratic Party of Korea criticized it as "an outrageous collusion," the People Power Party dismissed it, saying, "It's not something to apologize for." <<> Choi Eun-seok, the People Power Party's chief deputy floor spokesperson, met with reporters after a floor strategy meeting held at the National Assembly on the 31st and responded to questions about the text message, saying, "I view it as a casual exchange of opinions due to personal friendship," and added, "There was no particular discussion about it within the party." <<> He continued, "Personally, the issue arose from looking at a cell phone on the floor of the plenary session, and I don't think it's something (Yoon) needs to apologize for, but he seems to be feeling a bit uncomfortable himself." <<> When asked, "What exactly does 'casually exchanging opinions' mean?" Spokesperson Choi replied, "I didn't ask in detail. It was due to Yoon's personal circumstances." He added, "If lawmakers know someone (appearing as a witness) at a hearing or standing committee meeting, isn't it possible to reach out individually? Personally, there may be people with that kind of stance." <<> When asked, "Doesn't the party view this matter seriously?" Spokesperson Choi answered, "Yes." <<> In contrast, the Democratic Party issued a statement saying, "We strongly condemn lawmaker Yoon and former President Jung for mocking the hearing." Lee Ju-hee, the Democratic Party's deputy floor spokesperson, said in a written briefing released that day, "A lawmaker who should be uncovering the truth and a witness who should be held accountable engaged in an outrageous collusion in the middle of the hearing room, 'taking care of' each other and worrying about each other's well-being." She added, "This collusion scandal is an incident that, far from cutting off the absurdities in the football world, fully exposes the bare face of politics busy protecting and covering up corruption." <<> Earlier, on the 30th, the National Assembly's Culture, Sports and Tourism Committee held a hearing to investigate problems in the overall operation of the Korea Football Association, which came to light after the national football team's elimination from the round of 32 at the 2026 North and Central America World Cup, and summoned former head coach Hong Myung-bo and former President Jung as witnesses. At 1:50 p.m. that same day, Yoon, a committee member, sent a text message to Jung that read, "Chairman, this is People Power Party lawmaker Yoon Yong-geun. I was contacted by senior Jung yesterday. I should have taken better care of you... I'm sorry." Five minutes later, Jung replied, "Thank you for your concern. I will greet you in a different setting, not a place like this. From Jung Mong-gyu." <<> In response, Culture, Sports and Tourism Committee Chairperson Lee Jae-jung pressed Jung, asking, "During the preparation for the hearing, did you contact hearing committee members to lobby them?" Jung replied, "I asked what questions might be asked and whether there was anything I needed to prepare in advance," and apologized, saying, "If that was a problem, I feel quite sorry about it." <<> Yoon explained, "There was absolutely nothing (of value) exchanged, and I do not at all think that this made the hearing problematic or inadequate." <<> Reporter Jeon Kwang-jun light@hani.co.kr (윤용근 국민의힘 의원이 30일 국회 문화체육관광위원회의 대한축구협회 청문회 증인으로 출석한 정몽규 전 대한축구협회장에게 “더 잘 배려해 드려야 하는데…송구합니다”라는 문자를 보낸 것을 두고 여야는 상반된 입장을 드러냈다. 더불어민주당에서는 “기막힌 짬짜미”라고 비판했지만, 국민의힘은 “사과할 일은 아니”라고 일축했다.)
